This all falls within Gyeryongsan National Park. A well stocked tourist…

spots.name: Uam Historical Park
spots.desc: Historic scholarly site nestled in a mountain valley. Has a well kept lake and quite nice to stroll around. Hosts a (poorly gazetted) festival sometime in October. For hikers, the trail hidden at the rear-left of the park continues up the mountain, past a place to fill your water bottles and after a less than 30 min walk, all the way to the top of the ridge overlooking the immense Daecheong lake…

spots.name: Yuseong Foot Spa
spots.desc: A heated foot spa. The temperature is pretty high but varies along the length so it's appropriate even in winter, and you won't overheat in summer. Unlike most foot spas, the local populace demands pre-washing of feet at the wash-station at the end of the foot spa prior to entering (akin to the etiquette of a full body public bathhouse). Drop your stuff where you intend to sit, then walk down the…

spots.name: O-World
spots.desc: A theme park, on the far, far south end of the city. Comprises Zooland (zoo boasting 130 species), Flower Land (flower park boasting 190 species) and Joyland (a regular ol' theme park).

spots.name: Namsun Park Comprehensive Sports Center
spots.desc: It operates the only ice rink and wave pool in Daejeon, and is a comprehensive leisure sports center where you can enjoy various sports such as golf, squash, and futsal.

spots.name: Daedong Sky Park
spots.desc: It consists of Daedong Mural Village, Daedong Street Art Museum, Baegolsan Love Rock, Daedong Haneul Park Windmill, and Haneul Park Cafe.

spots.name: Daejeon Balloon Festival
spots.desc: Once a year around October, this is not the international balloon festival you are likely thinking of. The 2010 edition of this annual event only had two hot-air balloons, both tethered tightly to the ground. However, as the sun sets, they let off an amazingly large quantity of small disposable lantern balloons that float off in the south-westerly breeze of the neon Smart Towers housing complex…

spots.name: Cherry Blossom Festival
spots.desc: In Shintanjin, in April (spring) when the flowers happen to be in full bloom.

spots.name: Daejeon International Bread Festival
spots.desc: The Daejeon International Bread Festival is one of the city's signature annual events, celebrating Daejeon's status as the 'City of Bread' and a culinary hub for bakery arts. Held annually, the festival gathers famous local establishments—like Sung Sim Dang—and leading national bakeries, offering a massive variety of specialty breads and pastries. This vibrant event is a must-visit for food…

spots.name: Daejeon International Wine Festival
spots.desc: The Daejeon International Wine Festival is a major annual event that attracts global attention, positioning Daejeon as a central city for the international wine industry in Korea. The festival offers a vast array of global wines for tasting and purchase, alongside food pairings, educational seminars, and wine-related cultural programs. Held in conjunction with the Asia Wine Trophy competition, it…

spots.name: Shinsegae Department store Daejeon Branch
spots.desc: A major luxury department store in Daejeon offering premium brands, dining, and entertainment facilities.

spots.name: Galleria Department Store Timeworld
spots.desc: A flagship department store in Daejeon known for luxury brands, trendy fashion, and a wide range of dining options.

spots.name: Lotte Department Store Daejeon Branch
spots.desc: A major department store in Daejeon offering popular fashion brands, dining options, and convenient shopping facilities, including the famous bakery Sung Sim Dang on the first floor.

spots.name: Homeplus Yuseong Branch
spots.desc: A large hypermarket in Yuseong offering groceries, household goods, clothing, and casual dining options in one convenient location.

spots.name: Emart Dunsan Branch
spots.desc: A major Emart branch in Dunsan offering groceries, home goods, electronics, and daily necessities in a large, convenient shopping space.

spots.name: Costco Korea Daejeon
spots.desc: A large membership-based warehouse store in Daejeon offering bulk groceries, household goods, electronics, and imported items at competitive prices.

spots.name: Jungang Market
spots.desc: A large traditional market in Daejeon offering fresh produce, street food, clothing, and a lively local shopping experience.

spots.name: Daejeon Station Underground Shopping Center
spots.desc: An underground shopping arcade connected to Daejeon Station, featuring clothing shops, cosmetics, accessories, and affordable eateries.

spots.name: Nobrand Daejeon Jungchon Branch
spots.desc: A budget-friendly retail store offering groceries, snacks, and daily essentials at low prices in the Jungchon area of Daejeon.

spots.name: Mono Mart Daejeon Branch
spots.desc: A large global food ingredients market offering imported products, bulk items, and diverse international groceries.

spots.name: Indy
spots.desc: Indian restaurant on the north side of town. Service may be a little slow for some and their prices are in the higher range. Curry dishes come with free rice or naan. Vegetarian options are available.

spots.name: Loving Hut
spots.desc: Part of a chain of organic, 100% vegan, new pseudo-religious group-run restaurants. Menus in the chain vary between outlets: Shintanjin's mostly serves rice or noodle based fare, but has a Western-style fake-meat item. Prices typically under ₩5,000, owners are friendly and probably won't try to convert you. Fake-meat can also be purchased to take home. A second outlet may be opening near Expo…

spots.name: Sung Sim Dang
spots.desc: Established in 1956, this bakery has a wall full of past awards and credentials on display, the prices for baked goods are similar to elsewhere and they make their own macaroons. There is a food court upstairs serving typical continental fare.

spots.name: Flying Pan
spots.desc: Restaurant specialising in Italian style cooking and steaks, seemingly owned by the same folks as Sung Sim Dang next door. It's practically a local institution so cab drivers will know it. Has a separate cafe upstairs.

spots.name: Kraze Burger
spots.desc: A Korean dine-in burger chain with an outlet in Dunsan-dong, about one and a half blocks west from the main Timeworld intersection and on the north side of the road (backing on to the drinking precinct) and another near City Hall. Noteworthy because the chain has extensive mushroom/tofu options for those who don't eat meat.

spots.name: House Grill
spots.desc: Excellent burgers, arguably the best in Korea. Also offers chili fries, spaghetti, wraps, and huge donkatsu.

spots.name: sungsimdang
spots.desc: A famous bakery whose fried soboro and salt bread are delicious. Sungsimdang operates several branches in Daejeon, including its main store, Daejeon Station branch, Lotte Department Store branch, and DCC branch.

spots.name: Gwangcheon Restaurant
spots.desc: Located in Seonhwa-dong, it is a traditional duruchigi restaurant with more than 30 years of tradition.

spots.name: Jeongdongmoonhwasa
spots.desc: Financier, Egg Tart, Canule are sold on the same day of production.

spots.name: Taepyeongso rice soup
spots.desc: Soup rice, beef intestines soup, beef soup, boiled beef head slices, and beef sashimi are popular main dishes.

spots.name: Vesta
spots.desc: It is a premium Vesta buffet with top-notch dishes, elegant interiors, and five senses satisfaction, presented by 100 professional chefs.

spots.name: Jinro house
spots.desc: The stir-fried bean curd is spicy and has a deep taste, and the boiled pork is popular because it is soft and savory.

spots.name: Kimhwa Kalguksu
spots.desc: It is a place where you can have a hearty meal near Daejeon Station.

spots.name: Wolsanbonga
spots.desc: This is Daejeon's representative Korean restaurant, and galbi, naengmyeon, and galbitang are popular menus.

spots.name: Karamel
spots.desc: Karamel is a restaurant specializing in gnocchi and raw noodles pasta, and cabbage salad is also popular.

spots.name: Keungil Sikdang
spots.desc: Keungil Sikdang is a renowned local dining spot in Daejeon, highly praised for its authentic and hearty Korean comfort food, especially its signature Spicy Braised Chicken (Dak-bokkeum-tang). This establishment is a favorite among locals for its generous portions and deeply satisfying, traditional flavors. It offers visitors an excellent opportunity to experience the robust taste of classic…

spots.name: Mashinae Main Store
spots.desc: Mashinae Main Branch in Daejeon is a widely recognized dining spot, celebrated as the birthplace of the unconventional and highly popular dish, Kimchi Pizza Tangsuyuk (Kim-Pi-Tang). This unique fusion of deep-fried pork, kimchi, and melted cheese offers a distinctive local flavor profile that is a must-try for food adventurers. It’s highly recommended for those looking to experience Daejeon's…

spots.name: 5.5 Dakgalbi Yuseong Sangdae-dong-jeom
spots.desc: 5.5 Dakgalbi in Yuseong-gu is a highly popular franchise location known for serving some of the best stir-fried spicy chicken (Dakgalbi) in the area. This branch is recommended for a satisfying and communal dining experience, where the dish is cooked right at your table to perfection.

spots.name: sungsimdang cakeboutique
spots.desc: A cake shop near Sungsimdang, also known for its long queues.

spots.name: 정동문화사
spots.desc: This is a famous baked confectionery restaurant in Daejeon, and the price is very reasonable.

spots.name: Hare Hare
spots.desc: A bakery with a winning experience in an international baking competition. If you buy bread and drinks, eat on the second floor is available. The recommended menu is marked above, so it's easy to choose.

spots.name: Harupang
spots.desc: Harupang is a highly recommended stop on the Daejeon "bread pilgrimage" for visitors seeking specialty local bakeries beyond the big names. This charming dessert heaven is celebrated for its unique and visually appealing selection of pastries and bread. It offers a great opportunity to sample the diverse and high-quality baking culture Daejeon is known for.

spots.name: Cold Butter Bake Shop Headquarters
spots.desc: Cold Butter Bake Shop is a must-visit in Daejeon for lovers of rich, high-quality butter-based pastries. This main branch is famous for its exceptional selection of Scones and signature Salt Bread, which often sell out early in the day. Located in the heart of the city, it offers a sophisticated taste of Daejeon's modern bakery scene, making it a perfect spot for a premium coffee and dessert…

spots.name: Harehare Dunsan Branch
spots.desc: A bakery with a second-floor café where visitors can enjoy bread and desserts in a relaxed atmosphere.

spots.name: Green Bakery
spots.desc: A bakery known for its egg tarts with a rich, buttery flavor.

spots.name: Rorone Bakery
spots.desc: Popular for pairing fresh pastries with coffee in a cozy setting.

spots.name: Cold Butter Bake Shop Main Branch
spots.desc: Best known for its salt bread and often included on bakery tours in Daejeon.

spots.name: Hgeuimja
spots.desc: Specializing in cakes and desserts served in a calm and cozy atmosphere.

spots.name: Sweet Night Kitchen, Daejeon Daeheung Branch
spots.desc: A bar where you can eat sashimi, barbecue, and steak at the same time. It is a place where you can enjoy accompaniment with dinner with a cost-effective course meal.

spots.name: Wolves and Blue Stars
spots.desc: Wolf and Blue Star is a uniquely themed cafe in Daejeon known for its artistic and cozy ambiance, often featuring whimsical decor and high-quality beverages. It serves as a comfortable retreat, offering various specialty coffees, teas, and delicious, often homemade, desserts. This spot is highly recommended for those looking for a quiet, distinctive cafe experience far from the typical chain…

spots.name: Ociocoffee
spots.desc: The signature menu is "Ocioplot." Latte with black sesame ice cream

spots.name: Hide Out
spots.desc: Hideout is a cafe famous for its cake restaurants in Daejeon. More than 10 kinds of handmade cakes are prepared every day, and lemon cake with a combination of lemon curd's freshness and soft sheets is by far the favorite menu. The spacious interior of the store is decorated with a cute interior, and there are various seats such as an outdoor terrace and sitting area, so you can have a…

spots.name: A bite of the crescent moon
spots.desc: It is a brunch cafe that serves a variety of sandwiches in a cozy atmosphere. This place is a popular menu with sandwiches made with croissants and focaccia, which are baked using fresh ingredients, making it a comfortable place to visit alone. Also, it is possible to order in a group, making it suitable for visiting with multiple people.

spots.name: Incurve
spots.desc: It is an emotional cafe with the theme of Luck and Four-leaf Clover, and it is a great place to heal with a clean white-tone interior and various plants. The signature menu, Luck Latte, is topped with sweet white chocolate cream and four-leaf clover to satisfy both visual and taste. In addition, it provides visitors with a special experience by writing a guest book and meeting cute dogs.

spots.name: One It To
spots.desc: Located in Daejeon, this cafe offers cute interiors and various kinds of fruit acidity. In particular, fruit acidity is soft and delicious, with fresh fruit and soft cream in combination, and it is made with castella bread. It can be accompanied by a pet, and there is also a takeaway service.

spots.name: patisserie.lutz
spots.desc: Located in Dunsan-dong, Daejeon, the dessert cafe is famous for its cute Kkumdori tarts and a variety of baked confectionery. At the cozy store, you can feel the Christmas atmosphere, and it is perfect for dates as most seats consisting of two people. The signature Kkumdori tarts have citron filling in them for a refreshing taste, and a variety of desserts change with the seasons. In addition…

spots.name: Work Room Coffe
spots.desc: As an emotional cafe that offers a variety of desserts and drinks, parfait is especially popular using fresh fruits. Inside, the black tone creates a modern and clean atmosphere, and the photo zone and cute props add charm. It is positioned to be accompanied by pets and easy to use public transportation.

spots.name: Beaneer
spots.desc: It is a cafe that offers an emotional atmosphere and a variety of desserts. Especially, pistachio cream latte and fruit sando are popular, and they are suitable for dog owners because they can be accompanied by pets. The inside of the cafe is decorated with cozy and warm lights, so you can spend a comfortable time.

spots.name: Jelly Fore
spots.desc: It is a cafe full of cute props and Japanese sensibility. There is a variety of pudding and jelly menus, and custard pudding is especially popular. The menu is in the form of a diary, so it's fun to watch. The inside of the cafe is decorated with cute props, so there are many photo spots that are good for taking pictures. Also, you can accompany your pet, and takeout and delivery services are…

spots.name: Sumgyeol Coffee
spots.desc: A spacious café known for its traditional Korean shaved ice desserts and large second-floor seating area.

spots.name: Patisserie Sosin
spots.desc: Known for its beautifully crafted cakes, making it a popular choice for special occasions and gifts.

spots.name: Champ Space Coffee Roasters
spots.desc: A coffee roastery known for its warm atmosphere and carefully brewed specialty coffee.

spots.name: Monostone
spots.desc: A stylish café known for its photogenic interior and popular egg tarts.

spots.name: Oud Lune
spots.desc: A dessert café known for its salt bread and welcoming service.

spots.name: Mt. Gyeryong
spots.desc: Mt. Gyeryong is the third designated national park in South Korea and is 845 m high. The peak, Cheonhwangbong, is a restricted area, and there are many tourists to Donghaksa Temple. Mountain climbers often go up to the Donghaksa-Eunseon Falls-Gwaneumbong course or the Donghaksa-Namma tower-Sambulbong course.

spots.name: Gobok Nature Park
spots.desc: It is a park built around the Gobok reservoir. In the middle of the reservoir, there is a pavilion called "Minrakjeong(민락정)" where can see the scenery.

spots.name: Sejong Museum
spots.desc: Collect, study, and exhibit folk materials. Aiming to record life, folklore, culture, and art, it has a collection of more than 11,000 artifacts.

spots.name: Dweeungbark Village
spots.desc: Dweeungbark Village was created to inherit the traditional fermented sauces, and various exhibitions and experiences are prepared.

spots.name: Geumgang Pedestrian Bridge
spots.desc: It is the longest walking-only bridge in Korea, and the circumference was set at 1446 m in commemoration of 1446 when King Sejong the Great spread the Hangul. The upper floor is used for walking and the lower floor for bicycles.

spots.name: Jocheon Cherry Blossom Path
spots.desc: As one of the three cherry blossom paths in Sejong, cherry blossoms are spread along the water path that flows between Jochiwon-eup and Osong-eup.

spots.name: Sejong Central Park
spots.desc: It is a park consisting of the Jangnamdeul Plaza for various festivals and events, a complex sports facility where you can enjoy sports, a family leisure forest where you can enjoy leisure as a family, and a family art forest where you can hold small cultural events.

spots.name: Sejong Hangeul Festival
spots.desc: It is a citizen-participating urban culture festival with a variety of attractions and entertainment under the theme of "Hangul, Science, and Music" centered on King Sejong and talent in the Sejong era.
spots.addr: Sejong Lake Park, Sejong Central Park

spots.name: Jochiwon Peach Festival
spots.desc: It is a festival designed to help peach farmers secure sales channels, and consists of programs that can be enjoyed not only during the day but also at night under the theme of "Fresh Jochiwon Peach."
spots.hours: late July to early August every year
spots.addr: around the main streets, Sejong Civic Stadium

spots.name: Sejong Nakhwa Festival
spots.desc: It is a night festival that originated from the traditional Korean ritual, Nakhwa, which means falling flame. Nakhwa is a ritual of hanging Nakhwa Peak from branches, poles, or strings to blow away the negative energy while enjoying the shape and sound of the falling fireworks. The Nakhwa Festival promotes the unique intangible heritage of the region and allows people to enjoy high-quality…
spots.addr: Sejong Lake Park, Sejong Central Park

spots.name: Sejong City Light Festival
spots.desc: The Sejong City Light Festival, which was first held in 2023, is the representative winter festival of Sejong held in December, with various light sculptures and photo zones set up around Iungdari and waterside parks. Various performances and events held in the Christmas season, from December 22 to 25, and a countdown fireworks show for the New Year also held.

spots.name: Sejong Jeonui Landscape Tree Nursery Festival
spots.desc: Sejong Jeonui Landscape Tree Nursery Festival(세종 전의 조경수 묘목축제), 16-8 Manse-gil, Jeonui-myeon. Held every March. A local spring festival celebrating Jeonui's landscape tree and nursery industry. Visitors can see and purchase various trees and plants, participate in gardening and craft activities, and enjoy performances and other family-oriented programs. The festival also features free tree…

spots.name: Sejong Traditional Market
spots.desc: Opened since 1931, the 320-store market has vendors that sell local and nearby food, fruit, seafood, household goods and clothing.

spots.name: Sejong Daepyeong Market
spots.desc: A permanent market has been opened since the great flood in 1946, and 69 stores exist. In addition, there are many cultural resources such as the nearby Baekro habitat and Geumgang Natural Recreation Forest.

spots.name: Jeonui Wang-ui-mul Market
spots.desc: It was opened in 1946 and has about 70 stores. In addition, there are many tourism and cultural resources nearby.

spots.name: Bugang Traditional Market
spots.desc: It was opened in 1964 and has about 60 stores. The number of market users is estimated to be about 300.

spots.name: Jangwon Gap Kalguksu
spots.desc: It is a restaurant with a good menu composition, and has a large parking space, so it is accessible.

spots.name: Dangmiso
spots.desc: It is a popular Korean restaurant with Korean beef hot pot using shiitake mushrooms and beef ribs.

spots.name: Bapsang Charyeojuneun Jip
spots.desc: It is a famous restaurant in Sejong City, which is famous for various Korean table menus.
spots.addr: Room 215, Building A, Sejong Business Building, 232 Gareum-ro

spots.name: Fastars
spots.desc: The restaurant has a wide variety of menus that reinterpret authentic Italian cuisine in a modern way.

spots.name: Bugangok
spots.desc: It's a restaurant that's been selling sundae for three generations. It won the Blue Ribbon Award, and sometimes there's waiting.

spots.name: Jinsung Minsokchon
spots.desc: It is a restaurant with bone meat hangover soup and gamjatang as its main menu.

spots.name: Ongi
spots.desc: Brunch cafe with a comfortable atmosphere. It features a white and clean interior.

spots.name: Chungnam Sundae
spots.desc: Chungnam Sundae is a popular sundae gukbap restaurant located in Geumnam-myeon. With a good waiting system, visitors can enter relatively quickly, and visit conveniently by using a nearby public parking lot.

spots.name: Ariete
spots.desc: A brunch restaurant serving pizza, pasta, salad and sandwich brunch menus. Featuring baby chairs, it can also be visited with infants.

spots.name: molten Butter
spots.desc: Bakery offering a variety of breads and pastries, including its signature Molten Butter bread.

spots.name: Choi Hanok Cafe
spots.desc: Choi Hanok Cafe is a large three-story cafe located in Janggun-myeon, where you can use the second-floor space when you are accompanied by a dog.

spots.name: Leedo Coffee
spots.desc: Leedo Coffee Sejong Hotan Branch is a large cafe located in Geumnam-myeon, and offers a variety of drinks such as coffee menu, seasonal fruit juice, and herbal tea.

spots.name: Memory Factory
spots.desc: Memory Factory features a cozy atmosphere and spacious space. Coffee is available in a variety of choices, from hand drip to signature drinks.

spots.name: Coffee D
spots.desc: There are plenty of coffee menus and bakeries, Salted Cream Latte and Condensed Milk Latte are popular menus, and the combination of soft cream and strong coffee is impressive.

spots.name: Look Back
spots.desc: The menu is diverse, ranging from brewing specialty coffees to non-coffee beverages, with the Matcha Shot Green Spanner and Americano being especially popular.

spots.name: Beanstella Cafe
spots.desc: It features a large space and a variety of seating composition, and there are plenty of menu options such as handmade tea and seasonal drinks to satisfy various tastes.
spots.addr: 1st Floor, 2nd Floor, 3rd Floor, Building 1, 155 Taesan-ro, Yeondong-myeon

spots.name: Prdabang
spots.desc: A cafe with a view of the Geumgang River. Almost all tables are in a position with a view of the river, and it's easy to get by car because it's on the side of the road.

spots.name: Cafe Dankong
spots.desc: Woodton Interiors Cafe located near the Sejong Campus of Korea University. Coffee and black tea with salt cream are the signature menus.

spots.name: Cafe Beis
spots.desc: A spacious and pleasant second-floor cafe with terrace seating.

spots.name: Laforesta
spots.desc: A large cafe located near the Sejong Civic gymnasium and the Gobok Reservoir. It has a garden and exclusive use parking lot.

spots.name: Polar Bear Swim
spots.desc: A famous beach swim in the first week of January when the temperature is around 0°C. Hundreds of brave participants compete the cold in the sea. This event has run annually at the Choseon Beach Hotel since 1988.

spots.name: Busan International Rock Festival
spots.desc: Busan has been holding an annual Rock festival for 12 years now in August. Mostly Korean and Asian rock bands although some Western bands do appear.

spots.name: Sea Art Festival 2013
spots.desc: An art festival held on the beach every year from mid-September to mid-October.

spots.name: Busan Sailing
spots.desc: Haeundae has the largest leisure marina in Korea located about 10 minutes away from the beach walking in the direction of the Chosun Beach Hotel.

spots.name: Chicago Fitness Club
spots.desc: It is a great place to train. It has a wide range of cardio equipment, free weights (dumbbells up to 45 kg (100 lb)) and machines as well as golf practice facilities. It is located on the 5th floor of the Milligore Shopping Center in Seomyeon.

spots.name: Busan Bandits Rugby Football Club
spots.desc: An expat rugby club open to all residents of Busan and surrounding provinces. They play mainly 10's rugby and compete in the Korean Expat Rugby League (KERA). No previous experience required.

spots.name: Cherry blossom festival(gun-hang-jae)
spots.desc: There are possibly more cherry blossom trees to be seen here than in any other location in Korea, and although there are a couple of popular, groomed places for visitors to see them, you can find them strewn throughout the hillsides surrounding the town of Jinhae. During this period, some areas of the designated military navigation system will be opened to the public. Photographing inside the…

spots.name: Yong-ji Lake Park
spots.desc: There are the Changwon Citizen's Charter and Saeyoung Nampo Temple. In addition, the three-story stone pagoda of the Bulmo Mountain Dongsa Temple site excavated from Mt. Bulmo is restored in a circular form, and a music fountain is installed. The music fountain starts at 19:00. It does not occur between December and early March when the lake is prone to freezing. The Changwon Municipal Library is…

spots.name: Changwon Center Square
spots.desc: Anyone can enter. You can enjoy the round and large lawn. Occasionally, various events are held here. It is a lake in the middle of Changwon City's downtown area and is used as a resting place for citizens of Changwon City, and various art festivals, lantern festivals, and concerts are also held here. The music fountain in the lake is pretty. In addition, you can ride an eight-seater boat in the…

spots.name: Gwangsansa Temple
spots.desc: This temple is said to have been built by Wonhyo, a Buddhist monk from Silla, and Eunshin, a Chinese monk.

spots.name: Jeodo Skywalk
spots.desc: It is a 170-meter-long, three-meter-wide steel bridge. The bridge gained fame when a new bridge was installed in 2004 and was converted into a pedestrian bridge. After turning the bottom of the bridge into glass, it became a walkway. While crossing the sea, you can see the scenery of the sea 13.5 meters below. LED lights glow at night and create beautiful Milky Way roads. Summer season (March to…

spots.name: Kyungwha Market
spots.desc: Kyungwha Market is a folk market that is open on 8, 13 and 18 and 23 and 28 every month. It is close to Kyungwha Station, a famous cherry blossom spot in Changwon, so you can look around together. At the Kyungwha Market, you can see everything from fresh seafood from the Jinhae Sea to vegetables grown from home and fried chicken. Public parking lot available (41 in upper area and 86 in lower…

spots.name: Marine Drama Filming Site
spots.desc: Marine Drama Filming Site is a travel destination dating back to the Gaya era. With Masan's beautiful coast in the background, the building houses 25 wooden structures on the street and three ships. On the Site, you can experience the lifestyle and culture of the old times for yourself. It has been used as a filming location for various dramas and movies since it was created in 2010. 09:00-18:00…

spots.name: Jinhae Marine Park
spots.desc: Summer (March to October) 09:00 to 20:00, Winter (November to February) 09:00 to 18:00. Closed on the last Monday of every month. Marine Solar Park, Fish Ecology Learning Center, Naval Battle History Center, Marine Life Theme Park, and Coast Deckroad. Great place for children. It is located near the bridge of the Kwai River, and although not on a large scale, it is a beautiful place on the…

spots.name: Uilimsa Temple
spots.desc: Uirim is a thousand-year-old temple of tradition. Uirim Mountain, with its quiet forest trails, clear water, and cool shade, is a spiritual haven. Inside, there is a three-story stone pagoda in Uirimsa Temple, designated as a cultural property of South Gyeongsang Province, and a big quince tree that is hundreds of years old.

spots.name: House in Changwon
spots.desc: 200 years ago, it is a traditional hanok of the Joseon Dynasty where Ahn Doo-cheol, the fifth generation of Sunheung An Clan, lived.

spots.name: Metasequoire Garosu-gil
spots.desc: Changwon's representative cafe street. It is located near the Gyeongsangnam-do Provincial Office.

spots.name: Hiking
spots.desc: Hike around the many mountains that surround the city and catch wonderful views.

spots.name: Sports
spots.desc: Watch and bet on bicycle races, basketball (LG Sakers, based at LG Champion's Park), soccer (Gyeongnam FC, based at Changwon Football Center) or baseball (NC Dinos, based at Changwon NC Park). Play badminton on one of many public courts.

spots.name: Dotseom Island
spots.desc: Take a ferry out to Dotseom Island, which has a carnival and circus in Masan Bay.

spots.name: Changwon Ziptrek
spots.desc: If you take Changwon Ziptrek, you can experience a dizzying aerial flight of 1,399 meters from 99 tower to Sokuri island at a maximum speed of 80 kilometers per hour, and return to the jet boat. The time required is 30~40 minutes including safety training.

spots.name: Yongji Moving boat
spots.desc: It is an electric boat that can be easily operated by anyone. Visitors can enjoy the food and beverage they have prepared by driving on their own and enjoying it on the boat, which can be used as a cafe on the lake. Also, at night, the boat is lit with LED lights. 30 minutes, ₩20,000 for 4 people; 60 minutes, ₩30,000 for 4 people (+ extra ₩5,000 per person). Drinking and smoking in boats is…

spots.name: Wood Culture Experience Center
spots.desc: Museum of Wood Culture. It is a hands-on experience center where you can see and learn the importance of forest culture and the value of using wood. There is a comprehensive exhibition hall where you can see information about trees such as the history of wooden houses in Korea, the origin of trees, the growth of trees, and the history of the use of wood. There are also wood observation trails…

spots.name: Yangchon Hot Spring
spots.desc: Hot spring water from Yangchon Village is also popular as it is rich in minerals. The gentle nature of water helps promote blood and is effective in cases of neuralgia, rheumatism, neuropathy, insomnia, nervous breakdown, female reproductive cavalry, and skin disease. As there are many beautiful mountains around Yangchon Hot Spring, such as Inseong Mountain, Jeokseok Mountain, you can enjoy the…

spots.name: Mageumsan Hot Spring
spots.desc: Mageumsan Hot Spring is the first health spa in South Gyeongsang Province, offering a combination of treatment, recuperation and relaxation. It is known as the " Fountain of Mystery " as it can not be dried up no matter how much it is pumped through the mineral all-carie multI-salt hot spring that maintains water temperature of 45 ℃ or higher. It contains more than 20 kinds of minerals, which…

spots.name: LotteMart
spots.desc: It is the first large discount store in Jinhae. Fresh food, kitchen, fashion, consumer electronics, stationery, toys, a variety of customer convenience facilities (such as oriental medicine clinics, dental clinics, and animal hospitals), and a cultural center with parking lots.

spots.name: E-Mart
spots.desc: Paid parking: purchase amount less than ₩10,000 = 1 hour free, more than ₩10,000 = 2 hours free, over ₩30,000 = 3 hours free, more than ₩50,000 = 4 hours free. It is closed on the second and fourth Sundays of each month.

spots.name: Lotte Department Store
spots.desc: It is connected to Lotte Mart by underground passage. There is a movie theater called 'Lotte Cinema' on the third floor. Parking is available for a fee and can be used free of charge depending on the purchase price. ₩2,000 for the first 30 minutes and ₩500 for every 10 minutes thereafter.

spots.name: Lotte Mart
spots.desc: It is connected to Lotte Department Store by underground passage. Hi-mart, restaurant, fast food, cafe, fashion goods, cosmetics, nail bar, beauty salon, skin care, pharmacy, hospital, car wash, glasses, laundry, photo studio, bicycle shop. Also, There is a large wine shop. It is closed on the second and fourth Sundays of each month.
spots.addr: seongsan gu jung-ang dong jung-ang daelo 123

spots.name: Daedong Department Store
spots.desc: Amenity: If you go to the information desk on 1F, you can rent baby strollers while you shop. The Sky Park on the fourth floor offers a children's playground and a comfortable rest area.

spots.name: Bombay
spots.desc: Bombay is a nice Indian restaurant. Friendly staff and quick service. Prices are reasonable.

spots.name: Roll's Rice
spots.desc: Colorful dine-in sushi options and fusion dishes (think pastas, pilaf, omu-rice).

spots.name: Brown Hands
spots.desc: This is where the old cafe was reborn as a garage. If you go there, you can see the former garage.

spots.name: Mad for Garlic
spots.desc: Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays, A perfect spot for dates or special dinners, known for its reasonable prices and frequent promotions.

spots.name: Sushi Hon
spots.desc: Menu: Omakase, sushi sets, and lunch specials. Closed on Sundays. Renowned for its fresh sushi, high-quality omakase, and excellent service. One of the most popular sushi restaurants in Changwon.

spots.name: Moru Restaurant
spots.desc: A popular Instagram-worthy curry spot, ideal for casual dates or a cozy dining experience. Famous for its diverse curry options and stylish presentation.

spots.name: Pan Asia
spots.desc: A stylish Asian restaurant serving a variety of Southeast Asian dishes. Ideal for family gatherings, dates, and casual meals. Known for its generous portions and great service.

spots.name: Sushi Taro
spots.desc: An elegant sushi omakase experience with a rotating menu of seasonal and fresh ingredients. Widely regarded as Changwon's premier sushi restaurant.

spots.name: Belgrave
spots.desc: A trendy casual dining spot inspired by Australian cuisine, serving brunch, steaks, and pasta. Perfect for dates or gatherings with friends.

spots.name: Duksoo Pasta
spots.desc: A budget-friendly pasta restaurant offering unique Korean-style pasta dishes.

spots.name: Todos
spots.desc: A Mexican restaurant offering authentic dishes like tacos, fajitas, and platters.

spots.name: Nokuchon
spots.desc: Famous for its simple yet delicious kimchi stew paired with fluffy egg rolls. A perfect spot for a hearty local meal.

spots.name: Jangsuchon Pork Soup
spots.desc: A traditional local favorite specializing in hearty pork-based soups served around the clock.

spots.name: Dongbu Hoe Center
spots.desc: A budget-friendly seafood spot offering fresh sashimi and various seafood dishes.

spots.name: 1997 British House
spots.desc: British-themed café offering freshly baked bread, pastries (e.g., almond croissants, pretzels), and a unique "British Coffee" resembling an affogato with thick cream.

spots.name: Evans Coffee
spots.desc: Famous for its signature "Evans Coffee" (espresso topped with sweet coffee cream and rosemary). They also serve Syphon Coffee and a variety of desserts like caramel cheesecake and croffles.

spots.name: Elev
spots.desc: Modern café with ocean views, known for its aesthetic design and diverse offerings, including coffee, bread, and Japanese-style katsu from the attached "Sayakatsu."

spots.name: Offt Café
spots.desc: Famous for brunch menus, including avocado toast and savory pancakes, alongside signature lattes and handcrafted teas.

spots.name: Hokkilin Coffee Roasters
spots.desc: A must-visit for coffee enthusiasts, Hokkilin specializes in freshly roasted coffee beans with a variety of brewing methods (drip, espresso, etc.).

spots.name: Sur Café
spots.desc: Famous for Organic beverages and desserts, Herbal teas and fresh desserts, Green-themed interior perfect for relaxation

spots.name: Coffee San
spots.desc: Large 5-story cafe with ocean and mountain views. Famous for Signature coffees, smoothies, and desserts

spots.name: Bobos Café
spots.desc: Vintage-style café with an Instagram-friendly atmosphere. Famous for Croffles, cakes, and a variety of coffees

spots.name: Noted
spots.desc: Known for its elegant ambiance, this café is perfect for enjoying high-quality desserts and beverages in a luxurious setting.

spots.name: Bbangnaem (Baker's Scent)
spots.desc: A bakery café offering fresh, warm bread and coffee in a comfortable setting. It also provides parking space for convenience.

spots.name: Taehwagang National Garden (태화강 국가정원)
spots.desc: A large riverside national garden along the Taehwa River, known for its bamboo grove, seasonal flowers, and walking paths. Designated as South Korea's second national garden in 2019, it features the Simnidae bamboo forest, themed gardens, and riverside walking trails.
spots.hours: Open 24 hours; individual facilities may have different hours

spots.name: Black Pebble Beach at Gangdong and Jujeon Seashore
spots.desc: For those hoping for a view of the winter sea, or those longing for the engulfing embrace of the clear dark-blue waves crashing into huge rocks, Gangdong Pebble Beach is the place to be. The coastal road, with its beautiful scenery of the sea and mountains, is a popular driving route. With diverse attractions nearby, many vacationers are attracted to this beach in winter.

spots.name: The Night View of the Ulsan Industrial Complex from Mt Muryong
spots.desc: While looking over an industrial complex might not seem like a tourist attraction, the view is something out of Blade Runner or Koyaanisqatsi. Take your tripod to get the best night photos.

spots.name: Eoksae (Reed) Plain of Mt Sinbul
spots.desc: Mt Sinbul is the second tallest mountain in Ulsan, with a vast plain covered in reeds. Like Mt Gaji, it is considered to be one of the 100 most beautiful mountains in Korea.

spots.name: Seonbawi (Standing Rock) and Simnidaebat (Bamboo Grove) of Taehwa River
spots.desc: The combination of rocks, river and the bamboo forest create a breathing space in a highly industrial city. It is linked to the Taehwagang River Grand-Park.

spots.name: Paraeso waterfall
spots.desc: A 15-meter-high waterfall with the reflection of the mountain in the pool below.

spots.name: Whales Fantasium (웨일즈 판타지움)
spots.desc: An immersive media art exhibition featuring interactive digital displays inspired by whales and the marine environment of Ulsan. Opened in 2023, the exhibition includes themed spaces with audiovisual installations and interactive experiences. A cafe and observation area are located on the second floor.
spots.price: ₩1,000 for media art admission; ₩3,000 for a combined ticket with Whale Culture Village

spots.name: Ulsan Ilsan Beach
spots.desc: Ilsan Beach is a fine-grained sandy beach that is 600 m in length, 40-60 m in width, and 26,000 ㎡ in total area. The water is relatively shallow at 1-2 m in depth and holds an average temperature of around 21.2 °C during the summer months. Every July, there is a beach festival. Ilsan Beach offers various amenities and is surrounded by accommodation facilities, allowing for a comfortable and…

spots.name: Jinha Beach
spots.desc: Jinha Beach is a little slice of summer paradise measuring 1 km in length and 300 m in width. Like most beaches along the southern coast, the waters of Jinha are shallow, warm, and calm, making it a perfect place for swimming. The deep scent of the surrounding pine trees mixes with the sea breeze and gives the beach an intimate atmosphere despite its relatively large size. Camping is allowed in…

spots.name: Jujeon Mongdol Beach (주전몽돌해변)
spots.desc: A 1.5-km-long pebble beach known for its smooth, rounded black stones instead of sand. One of Ulsan's 12 scenic attractions, it is especially popular for the sound of waves washing over the pebbles. The coastline also features unusual rock formations, including Norangbawi and Saetdolbawi. Free parking and public restrooms are available nearby.

spots.name: Ulsan Taehwagang Bamboo Forest Horror Festival (울산 태화강 대숲납량축제)
spots.desc: An annual summer horror festival held in the bamboo forest of Taehwagang National Garden. Activities include horror trekking, theatrical performances, a horror mask dance party and themed interactive experiences. Check the latest festival announcements for dates, ticket prices and programmes.
spots.hours: Held annually in summer; the 2026 festival ran August 14-17, 20:00-23:30

spots.name: Ulsan Whale Festival (울산고래축제)
spots.desc: An annual festival celebrating Ulsan's maritime heritage and the history of Jangsaengpo, formerly a major centre of Korea's whaling industry. The event features cultural performances, parades, exhibitions and interactive programmes around the Jangsaengpo Whale Culture Special Zone. Festival dates, venues and activities vary each year.
spots.hours: Held annually; check the festival programme for dates and times

spots.name: Ulsan HD FC (울산 HD FC)
spots.desc: Ulsan's professional football club, competing in K League 1, South Korea's top football division. The team plays its home matches at Ulsan Munsu Football Stadium, one of the venues used during the 2002 FIFA World Cup. Visitors can experience Korean football culture and local supporters' chants during home matches. Check the club's official website for fixtures and ticket information.

spots.name: Ulsan Whales (울산 웨일즈)
spots.desc: Ulsan's professional baseball team, which began competing in the KBO Futures League, South Korea's professional baseball development league, in 2026. The team plays its home games at Ulsan Munsu Baseball Stadium. Visitors can watch baseball games in a stadium that also features outdoor seating areas and spectator facilities. Check the KBO website for match schedules and ticket information.

spots.name: Ulsan Samsan Wheat Noodles
spots.desc: It is a noodle that is only eaten in South Gyeongsang Province in Korea. It's a cool noodle called Milmyeon and you can taste the unique taste of Korea.

spots.name: Gyeongbokgung
spots.desc: A popular spot for premium hanjeongsik and charcoal-grilled beef, suitable for family or business meals.

spots.name: Sushi Kaiki
spots.desc: Intimate Edomae-style omakase with reserved seatings; advance reservations essential.

spots.name: Manjok
spots.desc: Casual, value-friendly jokbal/bossam specialist popular in the college district.

spots.name: Hamyangjip
spots.desc: Historic Korean restaurant (est. 1924) famous for traditional bibimbap and classic side dishes.

spots.name: Mimong
spots.desc: Late-night Japanese-style pub with small plates and drinks; a local favorite.

spots.name: OX Smoke & Broil
spots.desc: Casual grill house for smoked and broiled meats with a lively atmosphere.

spots.name: Namaskar
spots.desc: Long-running Indian restaurant serving classic curries and tandoori in the Samsan area.

spots.name: Eonyang Giwa Bulgogi
spots.desc: Classic Eonyang-style bulgogi grilled over charcoal with thin-sliced beef.

spots.name: Sapporo Ulsan
spots.desc: Premium Japanese dining with sashimi and course menus; good for groups.

spots.name: Seoga & Cook (Ulsan Mugeo Branch)
spots.desc: Casual western chain popular with families; generous platters and sets.

spots.name: Mijin Dol Gopchang (미진돌곱창)
spots.desc: A legendary local restaurant with over 40 years of tradition in Ulsan's famous Samho Gopchang Alley. It specializes in sizzling grilled beef tripe and intestines (gopchang gui) cooked on heated stone plates, as well as a rich, spicy tripe hot pot (gopchang jeongol) packed with vegetables and noodles. Finishing the meal with stir-fried rice on the hot plate is highly recommended.

spots.name: Shabeuondang Ulsan Samsan Branch (샤브온당 울산삼산점)
spots.desc: A shabu-shabu restaurant offering individual hot pots for each customer. The menu includes a variety of vegetables, meat, and other ingredients, as well as several broth options. Customers can select their preferred ingredients and broth for their meal.

spots.name: Pho Bay
spots.desc: Pho Bay is a great Vietnamese restaurant. Try the pho noodle soup.

spots.name: Ulsan Wholesale Fish Market
spots.desc: This market is similar to Jagalchi Fish Market in Busan. Customers choose their fish, and the fish is prepared on the spot. Prices are fixed but it can be possible to negotiate some extra fish at no additional cost, though vendors here generally do not speak English. Common dishes include hoe (raw fish, pronounced "hway"), sannakji (dead but still moving octopus), and various fish soups. A small…
spots.addr: Samsan-ro, 5-minute walk east from Lotte Hotel

spots.name: Art Street
spots.desc: A back street near downtown spanning approximately three blocks. It is full of artists and their works in galleries and nicely decorated store windows. In the evenings, it is lit up especially beautiful and provides a nice quaint walk a stone's throw from the most hectic pedestrian area in town. For artists seeking supplies, many of the stores also carry very affordable materials.

spots.name: The Traditional Culture Center
spots.desc: The center is near the entrance of Jeungsimsa Temple, at the foot of Mudeungsan Mountain. At the center, masters who have been designated as intangible cultural properties teach the public about traditional culture: Pansori (traditional Korean folk opera); Janggu (traditional drumming technique); Gayageum (traditional Korean zither). Performances are also held to demonstrate such elements of…

spots.name: Daein Market
spots.desc: A night market opens on every Saturday with artists, professional and amateur, showing and selling their creations on moving stands. The eye-catching goods include silver accessories, ceramics, handmade soaps, artisanal cutting boards, wood crafts, and paintings. The best selling items include bowls of hot soup with rice, pancakes made of mung beans or seafood and scallions, and pan-fried…

spots.name: Gwangju Student Independence Movement Memorial Hall
spots.desc: This monument is in the geographical middle of the city. Not widely known, and requires a taxi ride to get to, this monument is rather large and situated in a very quiet park atop a hill. The monument commemorates the student uprising against Japanese Imperialism in the early 1900s. The Park includes an impressive museum with detailed representations of the time. At times English tours are…

spots.name: Pung-am District
spots.desc: Within Pungam is the World Cup Stadium (월드컵 경기장), connected to the Lotte Outlet Mall. A short walk from the stadium is the Pungam Reservoir, which has fountains, statues, and a walking path. If you enjoy hiking, you can also take an easy hike around Geumdangsan Mountain, which encircles the Pungam residential area. Starting from an Oriental medicine hospital, Wongwangdae hospital, the hike takes…

spots.name: Kumho World Electronics Market
spots.desc: This market occupies 15 stories of an office building right behind the main U-Square Bus terminal. From the first basement to the seventh floor, electronic markets took occupancy of that, and from the eighth floor, the building is composed of studio apartments. The building is easily recognizable from its arched roof of glass sitting jutting out of the skyline. Each floor specializes in a…

spots.name: The Neighborhood of Yangnim-dong district
spots.desc: The neighborhood of Yangnim-dong district has a variety of modern and contemporary architecture and dense groves of massive 100-year-old trees. The establishment of a church, school, and hospital by Christian missionaries during the Japanese occupation earned the neighborhood the nicknames “Jerusalem of Gwangju” and the “Western Village.” There are some traditional Korean houses, including the…

spots.name: Jungoe Park
spots.desc: Jungoe Park is home to the exhibition and performance facilities of such events and institutions as the Gwangju Biennale, Gwangju Museum of Art, Gwangju Children’s Museum, Gwangju Culture Center; Gwangju Folk Museum, Gwangju National Museum, and the Gwangju Culture and Art Center. It also has sports and entertainment facilities, including Gwangju Children’s Grand Park; courts for tennis, gate…

spots.name: Chonnam National University's Back Gate Area
spots.desc: Chonnam National University is the largest university in Gwangju, home to several thousand students with a sizable foreign student and professor population. A popular hangout nearby is located at its back-gate, though it most certainly is more along the sides. Both the east and the west sides of the university have many cheap restaurants, clubs, bars, etc. To go to the west side, home of the…

spots.name: GWANGJU-KIA CHAMPIONS FIELD
spots.desc: The first-team baseball stadium was completed on February 28, 2014. It is the main stadium of Mudeung Stadium, and it is a baseball stadium right next to Mudeung Baseball Stadium. It has been used as the home stadium for the KIA Tigers since the 2014 season. It received great attention because it was the first-tier main stadium in 12 years since the opening of Munhak Baseball Stadium. It has the…

spots.name: Gwangju Bugs Land
spots.desc: Located inside Gwangju Family Land, it is a place where you can see various insects, reptiles, and animals.
spots.price: Free for Infants and toddlers, children ₩13000, Adults (from middle school students) ₩8000, elderly ₩ 4000
spots.addr: 677 Uchi-ro, Buk-gu, Gwangju, Gwangju Bugs Land in Gwangju Family Land

spots.name: Suwan District
spots.desc: Suwan is a very new district boarding Cheomdan. It has one of the only Toys "R" Us stores outside of Seoul, located in the Suwan Lotte Mart Complex.

spots.name: Songjeong dong and Tteok galbi street
spots.desc: Take the subway west and get off at Songjeong-ri station. From there, exit south and east and walk down past the row of Chinese markets. Songjeong has a large population of Chinese ex-pats, along with other Southeast Asians like Filipinos, Cambodians, Vietnamese, and Indonesians.

spots.name: 1913 Songjeoung Station Market
spots.desc: Songjeong Station Market has stood next to Songjeong Railway Station since 1913. Visitors can enjoy a variety of food options, such as sugar-filled griddlecake, fish cake, and croquette with the sights of red ginseng yogurt, egg fried rice, and skewers. It is popular with family visitors due to its large space, neat food, and friendly service, and it is also good to use as a cafe after meals as there are a variety of desserts and drinks.

spots.name: Cafe Moon. Anseong Wongok branch
spots.desc: There are a variety of drinks, and there are six cakes, bread, croffles, and Smore cookies, a special snack for camping, for mung fuccino and snacks and desserts that dogs can enjoy together. It's a place where dogs can be together, so it's a comfortable place where families can heal together.

spots.name: Jaegeonsa Coffee
spots.desc: "Jaegeonsa Coffee" is a brand that continues its valuable time with an attitude of respect and finding old traces of a 50-year-old stationery store "Jaegeonsa" familiar to Anseong local citizens. It is a heritage local coffee shop in Anseong with a local atmosphere.

spots.name: Cafe Chilgok Shop
spots.desc: It is a vintage roastery & bakery cafe, and it is a cozy and cozy atmosphere where you can share your memories. It is a space where you can take a break while tasting the 'Cafe Chilgok Shop' signature menu and 'Cafe Chilgok Shop' pride house blending, which provides only properly aged beans after roasting.

spots.name: The month of the 13th month
spots.desc: 'The month of the 13th month' is a dessert cafe, and the neat interior with a large parking lot and a photo zone is impressive. Seasonal cakes such as signature drinks such as 13th month latte, grapefruit tart, towel cake, and matcha roll cake, as well as bakeries such as salt bread and queen amang, are popular menus.

spots.name: Chat Baker Brunch & Bakery Cafe
spots.desc: The name 'Chat Baker' was inspired by 'Chet Baker', a legendary white jazz musician from the 20th century in the United States. Anseong's most healing cafe, Chat Baker Brunch & Bakery Cafe is a 1,650-m² emotional bakery cafe located in Gongdo-eup.

spots.name: Pyeongchon Art Hall

The main internal facilities of the library include a variety of archives, reading rooms, cultural classrooms, and audiovisual rooms. It has a total of 201,565 general books, 302 magazines and 57 newspapers, and 6,515 DVDs and 1,881 CDs as non-book materials. It is…

spots.name: Anyang Children Library

spots.name: Anyangmanan Culture Festival
spots.desc: It is a festival that conducts traditional weddings, past exams, reproductions, and celebratory performances.

spots.name: Anyang Dance Festival
spots.desc: It is a festival that hosts K-POP dance competitions, dance busking, exhibitions, experiences, and performances.

spots.name: Anyang Art Festival

spots.name: Anyang Tano Festival

spots.name: Anyang Youth Festival
spots.desc: It is a festival that hosts a comprehensive youth art festival, an experience booth, and performances.

spots.name: Anyang Art Park

spots.name: Anyang Stream Ecology

spots.name: Hogye Neighborhood Park
spots.desc: It is a good place to take a walk and exercise near the neighborhood.

spots.name: Hagun Park

spots.name: LOTTE Cinema Anyang 1st Street

Its convenient location and extensive retail selection make it a popular destination for both local shoppers and visitors from surrounding areas.

Free parking benefits are offered depending on the purchase amount, and selected stores provide tax refund services for international visitors. Thanks to its…

spots.desc: This is a shopping mall located in Beomgye Station. There is also a Lotte department store nearby, so many people come to shop.

spots.name: Anyang Agricultural and Marine Products Wholesale Market
spots.desc: Agricultural and fishery wholesale market located in Pyeongchon-dong, Dongan-gu. Construction began in 1994 when Pyeongchon New Town was in full swing and opened in 1997.

spots.name: LOTTE himart Bisan Branch
spots.desc: It is a home appliance sales company affiliated with Lotte Group.

spots.name: Emart pyeongchon Branch
spots.desc: An E-Mart branch near Pyeongchon Station selling groceries, household goods, and other everyday items.

spots.name: Emart Anyang Branch
spots.desc: Anyang E-Mart, which is the intersection of Gyeongsu Industrial Road and Gwanak-ro, and is a point of contact between Anyang Old Town and Pyeongchon New Town, and has good traffic communication on weekends, realizes the best customer satisfaction by expanding the waiting line of all-out channels and checkout counter, which consider customer convenience as much as possible, such as the composition…

spots.name: Hanaro mart Anyang Nnonghyeop Main Branch
spots.desc: It is a discount store and supermarket brand operated by Nonghyup Distribution, Nonghyup Hanaro Distribution, an affiliate of Nonghyup Economic Holdings under the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation, and regional agricultural cooperatives nationwide.

spots.name: Sinmen
spots.desc: This is Japanese ramen restaurant that is popular among regular customers. It is popular because it appears on the <I Live Alone> program.
spots.addr: Room 101 on the first floor of the 20th shopping mall, Hoseong street, Dongan-gu

spots.name: Casa
spots.desc: It is an Italian restaurant where pasta and pizza are delicious.

spots.name: Steam House
spots.desc: It is a restaurant where you can enjoy sensuous modern Chinese food by recreating local food with various ingredients from Hong Kong and China.

spots.name: Koi
spots.desc: Specializing in Japanese home-style cuisine, Koi is particularly famous for its Butadon (charcoal-grilled pork rice bowl) and Hanwoo Beef Tripe Rice Bowl.

spots.name: Cheonokjip
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in pork back-bone stew, which boasts a deep and thick taste of soup using domestic raw bones. Bone hangover soup is popular for its generous portions and tender meat, and the basic side dishes can be refilled at the self-bar.

spots.name: Bbicbbicdoyo
spots.desc: There is a variety of pasta and risotto menus, and pollack roe cream pasta and Ragu pasta are especially popular. Served as a base, the salad is great for piquing your appetite with fresh fruit and nuts.

spots.name: Museubitomo
spots.desc: Izakaya offers a variety of seafood dishes using fresh ingredients. Aged raw fish and abalone pasta are especially popular, and the seaweed salad served as a basic side dish is impressive.

spots.name: Anyang Central Market Sundae Gopchang Alley
spots.desc: A famous food alley lined with dozens of small restaurants specializing in stir-fried blood sausage (sundae) and pork intestines (gopchang) with spicy sauce, glass noodles, and perilla leaves.

spots.name: Gravier
spots.desc: This is a place where coffee, dessert, and space are combined in nature. It is good to enjoy the scent of coffee and music.

spots.name: Butterbeaver butique
spots.desc: This place is located in the Dongpyeon village and has an outdoor terrace. And there are various brunch using handmade cake and jam, handmade butter and cream cheese

spots.name: Hey Dough
spots.desc: This is a large cafe with a four-story building. The space is large, so you can feel comfortable.

spots.name: Rabbit's Bread
spots.desc: This is a cafe that is famous for its delicious salt bread. Many people line up to buy and eat bread.

spots.name: Rae Coffee Bar
spots.desc: It is a cafe that offers a variety of dessert menus along with coffee from a variety of coffee beans.

spots.name: Café Appeal
spots.desc: Nunetine Financier and Canule are popular and are suitable for enjoying tea.

spots.name: Posil Cake
spots.desc: It is a place where traditional Korean desserts are reinterpreted modernly and served with luxurious package designs. Suitable for gifts in a variety of set configurations, all products are carefully crafted by hand, using only healthy ingredients.

spots.name: Natural Ecology Museum
spots.desc: This museum is part of the Bucheon Natural Ecology Park, which includes a Botanical Garden, Mureung Dowon Arboretum, and Agricultural Antiquities Exhibition Hall. It features four exhibition halls: the Ecological Experience Center, River Ecology Center, Insect Museum, and Dinosaur Exploration Center. The first floor has live reptiles, amphibians, insects, and other animals, as well as an exhibit…
spots.price: Adults ₩4,000; middle and high school students ₩3,000; elementary school students ₩2,000.

spots.name: Bucheon City Museum
spots.desc: The museum focuses on the history and culture of Bucheon, offering insights into local heritage from prehistoric times.

spots.name: Bucheon Astronomical Science Institute
spots.desc: The institute offers educational programs related to astronomy, including lectures and observation opportunities.

spots.name: Bucheon bow Museum
spots.desc: The Bucheon Hwal Museum is a specialized museum that was opened to preserve traditional Korean bows, make national palaces, and continue the tradition of the palace. It has about 500 items related to bows, including 240 relics related to the palace of the late Kim Jang-hwan, the 47th National Intangible Cultural Property. Bows and arrows from ancient times to modern times, tools and records…

spots.name: Bucheon water Museum
spots.desc: The Bucheon Water Museum is a special experience space where you can directly experience the birth and disappearance of water, the history of water use, and the importance of water through various videos and exhibits, and see the production process of tap water we drink at a glance.

spots.name: Gimpo International Sculpture Park
spots.desc: It is the natural art space where art works wishing for peace harmonize with recreational forests of Munsusan Mountain.

spots.name: Gimpo Art Village
spots.desc: A family-friendly cultural space housed in Korean "hanok" traditional houses, Gimpo Art Village blends tradition and contemporary art. Visitors can tour art exhibits, participate in hands-on activities, and enjoy performances held at the village.

spots.name: Aegibong Peace Eco Park
spots.desc: Visit the observation deck for a rare view of North Korea's Kaepung County and the Han River estuary. The park features peace-themed exhibitions and ecological trails, making it a unique historical and nature experience.
spots.price: KRW 3,000 for adults, KRW 2,000 for teenagers/military police, KRW 1,000 for children

spots.name: Gimpo Peace Culture Center
spots.desc: Located within the Gimpo International Sculpture Park, this unique building is constructed from shipping containers to symbolize Gimpo's proximity to the North Korean border. It features exhibition halls dedicated to the themes of peace and unification, including VR/AR experiences of North Korean life and a video room.

spots.name: Laveniche March Avenue Waterfront Park
spots.desc: Laveniche March Avenue is a picturesque canal-side complex in Gimpo, inspired by Venetian architecture and atmosphere. The area features a scenic artificial waterway called the Golden Waterway, making it a popular spot for walks both day and night. Bridges and curved canals run alongside European-style commercial streets lined with cafes, restaurants, and boutiques.

spots.name: Gimpo Hamsang Park
spots.desc: Korea's first battleship-themed park, featuring a retired LST battleship on display. The park includes educational exhibits about naval history, interactive experiences, and is popular with families and children.

spots.name: Ara Marina
spots.desc: Ara Marina is a riverside leisure complex offering yachting, water sports, and dining options. The marina hosts seasonal events and is a perfect destination for enjoying the outdoors along the Ara Waterway.
spots.price: Prices vary widely by activity (Boat tours, Yachting, Kayak rentals)

spots.name: Gimpo Four Seasons Sledding Park
spots.desc: Enjoy sledding year-round, regardless of the weather. The park offers snow sledding in winter and water sledding in summer, making it a popular family destination for seasonal recreational activities.

spots.name: Gimpo Art Hall
spots.desc: The city's main public performing arts center, hosting diverse events including classical concerts, musicals, and plays. Check the official website for the monthly performance schedule.

spots.name: Tongjin Dure Cultural Center
spots.desc: The cultural hub of northern Gimpo, dedicated to preserving "Tongjin Dure," the traditional farmers' cooperative culture and folk arts of the region. The center hosts various traditional performances and includes a promotional exhibition hall where visitors can learn about the history and significance of the unique "Tongjin Durenori" performance.

spots.name: Small Museum Bogugot
spots.desc: A fascinating small art museum located in the border village of Bogugot-ri. It is famous for being the first museum in Korea created by remodeling an old civil defense shelter (bomb shelter). The space itself serves as a symbol of turning a place of tension into a place of art and peace, hosting various exhibitions by local artists.

spots.name: Gimpo Art Storage
spots.desc: Originally an idle agricultural warehouse used for storing grain, this space has been transformed into a vibrant public art studio. It serves as a creative residency for professional artists and offers various cultural education programs and stone sculpting experiences for the community and visitors.

spots.name: Gimpo Laveniche Maritime Festival
spots.desc: A popular festival held every autumn along the Venetian-style canals of Laveniche. It features boat parades, street performances, food trucks, and a spectacular water screen show and fireworks display.

spots.name: Gimpo Marine Corps Culture Festival
spots.desc: Celebrating the strong historical presence of the Marine Corps in Gimpo, this festival offers visitors a chance to participate in marine drills, view military equipment, and enjoy cultural performances. It’s a unique experience for military enthusiasts.

spots.name: Daedong Pungeoje Commemoration
spots.desc: A traditional, historically significant event rooted in the local fishing village culture, praying for a safe year and abundant catch. While smaller than the others, it showcases the maritime heritage and traditional rituals of Gimpo's coastal areas.

spots.name: Laveniche March Avenue
spots.desc: Laveniche March Avenue is a lively shopping street and cultural district featuring boutique stores, trendy cafes, and restaurants. Visitors can enjoy live street performances, public art, and seasonal festivals. It’s a great place for shopping, dining, and soaking up the local atmosphere.

spots.name: Hyundai Premium Outlet Gimpo
spots.desc: A premier shopping destination near Gimpo International Airport offering over 230 high-end brand stores. Shoppers can find discounted fashion, footwear, and accessories in a stylish environment. The outlet also hosts seasonal sales and cultural performances.

spots.name: Gimpo Lotte Mall
spots.desc: A large lifestyle shopping complex with numerous retail shops, restaurants, a cinema, and entertainment facilities. Connected conveniently to the airport by an underground passage, it offers a wide range of Korean and international products with a modern shopping experience.

spots.name: Gimpo Market (Held on days ending in 2 and 7)
spots.desc: The largest traditional five-day market (오일장) in Gimpo, held on the 2nd, 7th, 12th, 17th, 22nd, and 27th of each month. The market is set in the Bukbyeon public parking lot and offers a wide variety of goods at very affordable prices, including fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, seafood, clothing, bedding, household items, and various other products. Visitors can enjoy sampling local foods such as…
spots.hours: Held on the 2nd, 7th, 12th, 17th, 22nd, and 27th of each month (08:00-18:30)

spots.name: Daemyeong Port Seafood Market
spots.desc: Buy fresh seafood, including various types of raw fish, salted seafood (Jeotgal), and dried fish, directly from the fishermen at competitive prices. It offers an authentic local experience near the West Sea.

spots.name: Gimpo Nonghyup Local Food Market
spots.desc: A must-visit for travelers seeking to buy authentic local products, especially the renowned Gimpo Geumsal (rice), along with fresh vegetables, fruit, and other locally grown goods directly from Gimpo farms.

spots.name: Deungchon Kalguksu
spots.desc: Famous for its spicy Mushroom Shabu-Shabu Kalguksu (knife-cut noodles). The set meal includes vegetables, meat, noodles, and fried rice (볶음밥) to finish, offering great value.
spots.price: Shabu-shabu kalguksu is priced around ₩10,000 to ₩13,000 per person

spots.name: Choigane Hanjeongsik
spots.desc: A popular spot for Hanjeongsik (Korean set course meal). It serves a variety of seasonal side dishes and traditional food using fresh, local ingredients, ideal for groups or formal dining.
spots.price: Full traditional Korean set menus (Hanjeongsik) start from around ₩30,000 per person up to higher-end course options

spots.name: Pyeongchang Makguksu
spots.desc: Specialized in Makguksu (buckwheat noodles) and Suyuk (boiled pork slices). The simple, clean taste of the broth and chewy noodles makes it a local favorite during summer.
spots.price: Main dishes like makguksu (buckwheat noodles) are generally ₩10,000 to ₩12,000

spots.name: Gimpo Bori-gukbap
spots.desc: Serves hearty Bori-gukbap (barley rice soup) and bibimbap with fresh vegetables. Known for its generous portions and healthy, rustic Korean flavor.
spots.price: Boribap (barley rice) and similar traditional meals are generally ₩9,000 to ₩10,000

spots.name: Minsok Chueotang
spots.desc: A well-regarded spot for Chueotang (loach soup), a nutritious and warming Korean dish. The soup is rich and deeply flavored, perfect for cold weather.
spots.price: Chueotang (loach soup) costs ₩11,000 to ₩13,000 per serving

spots.name: Daege-Jang
spots.desc: As it is right near the port, this restaurant specializes in extremely fresh snow crab (대게) and other seafood dishes. Guests can select their crab directly from the tank.
spots.price: Signature dishes like Ganjang Gejang (soy-marinated crab) set menus start around ₩30,000 to ₩40,000 per person

spots.name: Gimpo-guksu (Local Noodle Shop)
spots.desc: A simple, popular spot for inexpensive and delicious Janchi-guksu (feast noodles) and Bibim-guksu (spicy mixed noodles). It's a true local's lunch favorite.
spots.price: Noodle dishes (Guksu) are very affordable, ranging from ₩7,000 to ₩9,000

spots.name: Silla Samgyetang
spots.desc: Known for its high-quality Samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup). A rich and healthy meal, perfect for boosting energy during hot summer days or cold winters.
spots.price: A serving of samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup) is typically ₩17,000 to ₩20,000

spots.name: Seohae Oyster & Clam Steamer
spots.desc: Highly recommended for its fresh steamed clams and oysters (조개찜/굴찜), sourced directly from the nearby West Sea. A perfect place to enjoy authentic Korean seafood with soju.

spots.name: Little Paulo
spots.desc: A European-style bakery café in Yangchon-eup known for its delicious salt bread and coffee. The spacious interior and pet-friendly atmosphere make it popular among both locals and visitors.

spots.name: Cafe de Chelsea
spots.desc: Famous for its large garden with a Christmas atmosphere, this café is perfect for relaxing with seasonal drinks and beautiful photo spots.

spots.name: Forerium Gallery Café
spots.desc: Combining a café and art gallery, Forerium offers a calm ambiance with coffee, bakery items, and a kids’ area, making it ideal for families and art lovers alike.

spots.name: Surisa Temple
spots.desc: Surisa Temple was founded in the southwest region of Mount Surisan during the reign of King Jinheun (539-575 AD) of the Silla Dynasty. The temple is part of the Yongjusa Temple, which is the regional headquarters for the Jogyejong branch of Buddhism. The founder of the temple is unknown. The Buddhist monk Unsadaesa named the temple, which means 'one will see the Buddha in person and become a…

spots.name: Taeeulbong Peak
spots.desc: Taeeulbong Peak is a place where the forest is still very well preserved. Here you can find public facilities for exercising and relaxing, as well as hiking trails.

spots.name: Dang Forest of Deokgogae
spots.desc: Located in Daeyami, this grove contains mature oak and beech trees, many of which are 100–200 years old. It received the grand prize in the 3rd National Beautiful Forest Contest.

spots.name: Galchi Reservoir
spots.desc: Galchi Reservoir is located near 75 Sokdal-dong in Jeongjandeul in the northern part of Daeam. This reservoir was completed in 1984 and can accommodate 8.6 ha of water to a depth of 8 m. On weekends or holidays, many people spend time in this reservoir fishing.

spots.name: Cherry Blossom Path of Gunpo
spots.desc: A cherry-tree-lined walking route near Geumjeong Station. In spring, the blooming trees form a continuous canopy along parts of the path, making this one of Gunpo's seasonal walking routes.

spots.name: Royal Azalea Hill
spots.desc: Planted with 90,000 azaleas and 27,000 wild grasses, the azalea hills are in full bloom from late April to early May every year.

spots.name: Chomak-gol Eco-Park
spots.desc: An eco friendly forest path in the middle of city which people and mature blend and communicate together. There are also public restrooms and a café inside the park. Also, note that there is no trash bin.

spots.name: Banwol Lake Park
spots.desc: A lakeside park around Banwol Lake, known for its quiet scenery and sunset views. It has a walking path around the lake and is a popular place for walking and relaxing.

spots.name: Royal Azaleas Festival
spots.desc: The Royal Azalea Festival, which is held at the time of the royal azalea blooms, consists of various events. The events include concerts, exhibitions, experience events, love letter writing and sketch contests which serve to provide many opportunities to enjoy the beauty of Royal Azalea Hills.

spots.name: Gunpo Reading Festival
spots.desc: A book and reading festival with author events, book markets, performances, reading activities, and programs for visitors of different ages. The 2026 main event is held on 24 October.

spots.name: CGV Sanbon
spots.desc: It was built where the former Lotte Cinema used to be, and is relatively small in size.

spots.name: Gunpo Urban Corporation National Sports Center
spots.desc: It has a variety of facilities such as a swimming pool, soccer field, track and field, table tennis, badminton, climbing gym, and a fitness center, and it was built relatively recently, so it is clean.

spots.name: Ogsang Sikdang
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in Japanese cuisines. It will move to another location on September 20, 2026.

spots.name: silver
spots.desc: 0507-1468-2098A variety of menus such as hot pot rice set, cockle dishes, and whole duck soup with shingled hedgehog and medicinal herbs are provided, and satisfaction is high.

spots.name: Opus
