spots.name: Sushi no yuki
spots.desc: Sushinoyuki is a rotational sushi restaurant located on the second floor near exit 3 of Sanbon Station.

spots.name: Damso Sosagol Sundae Yukgaejang (Gunpo Dangjeong Branch)
spots.desc: A casual Korean restaurant serving sundae-guk (Korean blood sausage soup), yukgaejang (spicy beef soup), and other Korean soup dishes.

spots.name: Mentzuru
spots.desc: A famous restaurant serving Japanese ramen. There are branches in various regions, but this is the main office.

spots.name: Cafe Untie
spots.desc: A stylish dessert café known for its wide-cookie selections, specialty coffee brews and relaxed interior at Sanbon Rodeo Street.

spots.name: Cafe Papio
spots.desc: A large and modern café near Sanbon Station offering “Cream Brûlée Schneider” and other dessert-rich menus, dog-friendly space, great for friends or a relaxed afternoon.

spots.name: Cafe The Tree
spots.desc: A calm neighbourhood café full of green plants and wood-tone interiors; ideal for cozy chats or reading time, with signature desserts and lattes.

spots.name: Cafe PAAM
spots.desc: A bright café with large windows and a relaxed atmosphere in the heart of Sanbon. Known for its expansive dessert menu and warm, inviting space—great for a casual date or a peaceful afternoon coffee.

spots.name: How Tasty
spots.desc: HowTasty is a cafe with a comfortable atmosphere and a variety of menus in Dang-dong, Gunpo. Its signature drinks, Howlatte and Howmocaratte, feature a soft taste, and for handmade desserts, Bachike and Chewy Whinnang Ball are popular.

spots.name: Cozy Mansion
spots.desc: Cozy Mansion is a cozy Sanbon Station cafe that provides a comfortable space with a combination of wood-toned interiors and emotional props. Handmade desserts such as brown cheese caramel latte, chodang corn cream coffee, and various scones and financiers are popular.

spots.name: Dongyang Tea House Sanbon Store
spots.desc: It is a tea house sold by oriental tea and delicious snacks.

spots.name: Joseph Paris
spots.desc: Joseph Paris is a bakery cafe that specializes in French bread, offering a wide variety of baguettes, ciabatas, croissants, and more.

spots.name: cafe cony
spots.desc: A quiet café with various guests' paintings hanging on the walls

spots.name: Gonjiam Bandi Forest
spots.desc: It is a space where you can see various plants, some of them bulbous.

spots.name: Gonjiam Ceramic Park
spots.desc: This is an experiential complex cultural space where anyone can see, experience, and enjoy, with sculpture parks, ceramic shopping malls, complex cultural halls, performance halls, Paleolithic experience yards, and Jungang Lake Plaza.

spots.name: Gonjiamcheon
spots.desc: It flows through Gonjiam-eup, Docheok-myeon, and Sangdo-eup and joins Gyeongancheon Stream.

spots.name: Yulbom Botanical Garden
spots.desc: This is a Rural Art Theme Park, where you can experience cultivating vocational agriculture.
spots.price: Adult ₩5,000, middle and high school student ₩4,000, child ₩3,500, riding a rail sled (30 minutes) ₩5,000

spots.name: Bunwon Kiln Site
spots.desc: In Joseon Dynasty era, in most of the areas of Gwangju, there were Guanyaos (官窯) where manufactured ceramics that were used by royal family. The organization directing it, that is, a branch of Saongwon (司饔院), was located in Namjong-myeon, Bunwon-ri. Here, a number of high-quality white porcelains were manufactured at the time. Bunwon White Porcelain Museum, which was opened in 2003, uses the…

spots.name: Hanok Village in Gwangju
spots.desc: The ancient Korean house in Gwangcheon, which is more than 400 years old, has been relocated and restored. 1,000-year-old zelkova trees and pine trees harmonize with the hanok to change new clothes every season. In the beautiful nature, you can feel the tranquil atmosphere of the hanok and feel the relaxation of your life. It operates programs based on family, nature and art, including outdoor…

spots.name: Mt. Taehwa
spots.desc: Mt. Taehwa (664 m) at Chugok-ri is a low mountain with an acute peak. Nearby is Gonjiam Someori Gukbab Town and many fishing grounds that attract many visitors. On the southern skirt of the mountain is Baengnyeonam, which is said to have been built by Prist Iryeon in the 12th year of the reign of King Chungsuk of Goryeo. Beneath Daeungjeon is the legendary “Janggunsu,” which provides hikers with…

spots.name: Jungdae Mulbit Park
spots.desc: Jungdae Mulbit Park wax built on an artificial lake that provided water for agricultural use. It is now a waterside park equipped with playing facilities for kids, sports facilities, a fountain square, and so on. In the park, there are an observatory, the rose tunnel, the lotus road, an arch wooden bridge, an amplified fountain, and so on.

spots.name: Olive Young
spots.desc: It is a health and beauty store and sells other household items mainly in cosmetics.

spots.name: Emart
spots.desc: Emart is South Korea's largest discount retailer, offering a wide range of products from groceries to household goods.

spots.name: No Brand Gwangju Taejeon Store
spots.desc: A popular no-frills supermarket that offers a wide range of products, including food, daily essentials, and more. It has a cashless store feature

spots.name: Gwangju Food Warehosue
spots.desc: A large, well-stocked store with a wide range of groceries and local food items. Popular among locals for its variety and affordability.

spots.name: Cheongsan Kalguksu
spots.desc: It is a store that sells vegetable kalguksu (Korean Noodles). It also sells dumpling soup and other foods.

spots.name: Modori Restaurant
spots.desc: The restaurant is in the CGV Gwangju building, and parking is available. It specializes in sushi, ramen, and other Japanese cuisine, making it a popular choice for family meals or date spots.

spots.name: Yangsikjip
spots.desc: "Yangsikjip" is a Western-style restaurant in Gwangju, Gyeonggi-do, offering a variety of dishes such as pasta, gnocchi, and lasagna, renowned for its excellent value for money. Signature dishes like black sesame shrimp cream pasta and creamy gnocchi are particularly popular among patrons, showcasing unique flavors and satisfying portions.

spots.name: Nagahori Ramen
spots.desc: "Nagahori Ramen" is a Japanese-style ramen restaurant in Gwangju, Gyeonggi-do, known for its rich broth and tender, flavorful chashu (roast pork). The cozy interior and clean setup make it an ideal spot for casual dining, including solo meals. Popular dishes include traditional tonkotsu ramen, spicy ramen, and chashu rice bowls. The restaurant's homemade noodles pair excellently with the savory…

spots.name: Blooming Hill
spots.desc: Located on a hill with a scenic terrace and forest surroundings, it’s perfect for a quiet retreat. This cafe welcomes pets on the terrace.

spots.name: Project Hillside
spots.desc: Known for a rooftop garden, this cafe offers fresh-baked pastries and a cozy industrial-chic interior.

spots.name: Cafe in Sinhyeonri
spots.desc: Set within a birch forest, it offers outdoor seating for a peaceful coffee experience among the trees.

spots.name: Puddle House
spots.desc: Surrounded by forest, it features a terrace, café, and bistro on the lower level. Known for carrot cake and relaxing ambiance.

spots.name: Farmers Daddy
spots.desc: This garden cafe, complete with a greenhouse, is ideal for families. Admission includes a drink, and it offers a scenic escape from urban life.

spots.name: Namyang Sports Park
spots.desc: It is a park equipped with various amenities such as a wetland garden, a library, and sports facilities. It is also called the Green Health Garden Park.

spots.name: Zoolung Zoolung Zoo Dongtan Branch
spots.desc: It is an indoor zoo with about 50 kinds of aqua cafes, including penguins, sharks, rays, and discuses. It also has an indoor playground of 150 pyeong.

spots.name: Dongtan Lake Park
spots.desc: It is a park built around the Sancheok Reservoir and Songbangcheon Stream in Dongtan New Town, providing a space for Hwaseong City and nearby residents to relax and enjoy various cultures. It is a well-being space in the city with a wide lawn along the lake, a large picnic area, and a phytoncide forest.

spots.name: Grandpa Animal Farm
spots.desc: It is an animal farm with a dog playground, an indoor animal experience center, an indoor playground, an outdoor playground, a rose garden, an unmanned cafe, and a snack bar. It is a place where dogs can experience food.

spots.name: Hwasan Sports Park
spots.desc: It is a park equipped with facilities for various sports and leisure activities. Inside the park, there is a soccer field, basketball court, tennis court, and various sports facilities, providing a space for locals and visitors to enjoy various sports.

spots.name: Botong Reservoir
spots.desc: It was first built to supply agricultural water, and there are trails centered on the Dulegil and the fishing area.

spots.name: The red lighthouse of Jebudo
spots.desc: It is one of the major landmarks of Jebudo. The lighthouse stands out in vivid red against the backdrop of Jebudo's West Sea, and is favored as a place to enjoy the scenery and take photos. The area around the lighthouse has well-maintained trails and waterfront.

spots.name: Sinheungsa
spots.desc: The temple was constructed in 1934. Focusing on the edification of children and adolescents, the temple has created many programs such as a daily Buddhist retreat and a summer Buddhist school for children to carry out missionary work. Shinheungsa Temple is famous for its children's Dharma meeting, and its signboards and contents are written in Korean, not in Chinese characters. The stairs leading…

spots.name: Hwaseong City Our Flower Botanical Garden
spots.desc: Hwaseong City's Woori Flower Botanical Garden has an observatory, a walkway, our flower room, and an indoor viewing hall.
spots.hours: Nov-Feb: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00; Mar-Oct: Tue-Sun 09:00-18:00; closed on Mon

spots.name: Seohaerang Jebudo Marine Cable Car
spots.desc: A cable car connecting Jeongok Port and Jebudo, with views of the coast and tidal flats. Children aged 36 months through primary-school age qualify for child tickets. Operation may change or stop in bad weather. Telephone within South Korea: 1833-4997.
spots.hours: M–F 09:00–19:00; Sa Su and public holidays 09:00–20:00. Ticket sales end one hour before closing; boarding ends 30…
spots.price: Standard cabin return: adults ₩22,000, children ₩18,000; one-way: adults ₩19,000, children ₩16,000. Glass-floor cabin…

spots.name: Ani Land
spots.desc: A space where birds/outdoor zoos are combined, a nature-friendly experiential learning space near Jeongok Port in Hwaseong.
spots.price: Fall weekday usage fee (the same for adults and children) ₩10,000, Spring and autumn weekend fees (the same for adults…

spots.name: Soda museum
spots.desc: A design/architecture-themed exhibition space, which is rare in Korea, reinterpreted as an art museum by remodeling an abandoned large jjimjilbang (bathhouse) building.

spots.name: Artis Theme Park
spots.desc: It is a theme park where visitors can do live ecological experience programs such as feeding experience, communication experience, and interactive experience.
spots.addr: 9th floor of Shinyu Medi Plaza, 10, Dongtan-daero 19-gil

spots.name: Central Insect Ecological Farm
spots.desc: Insects, hamsters, rabbits, pigs, goats, sheep, alpacas, bed carp, parrots, and various reptiles that are not common in urban areas can be seen right in front of visitors eyes. Outside food is also allowed to be brought in.
spots.addr: Central Insect Ecology Farm, 225 Seja-ro, Jeongnam-myeon

spots.name: Baekmi-ri Fishing Village
spots.desc: In line with the nickname of "a village with 100 flavors," jukkumi in spring, milguk octopus in summer, autumn prawns and gizzard shad are famous, and visitors can enjoy a variety of experiences such as dry net experience, poisoning experience, boat fishing experience, and skin scuba experience.

spots.name: Naturescape Plus
spots.desc: Indoor theme park for children. It has various spaces including media art and playgrounds.

spots.name: Lotte Department Dongtan
spots.desc: A department store where you can enjoy various brands, restaurants, and cultural activities.

spots.name: Metapolis Mall
spots.desc: A shopping complex with retail stores and places to eat. Blocks A and B are connected by a passage. A service desk on the second floor of Block A handles visitor enquiries and stroller and wheelchair loans.
spots.hours: Daily 10:30–22:00; individual stores may have different hours

spots.name: Changsimgwan
spots.desc: Specializing in grilled pork, such as pork belly, neck, and hanjeongsang. The signature dish is aged pork belly.

spots.name: Gaein Cafe
spots.desc: Gaein Cafe is a pet friendly, no-kids cafe with entry restricted to guests aged 14 and over. Dogs up to 12 kg are allowed, excluding designated restricted breeds. The venue includes a large natural grass outdoor playground, an indoor artificial turf area, and a spacious café interior designed with multiple photo zones.

spots.name: Ha Yan Pungcha Bakery
spots.desc: Ha Yan Pungcha Bakery is offering a variety of bread items, including cheese baguette and rice baguette. Beverage selections include coffee, decaffeinated drinks, and non-coffee options.

spots.name: Heygeul
spots.desc: Heygeul is a cafe specializing in bagels and coffee-based drinks. The menu includes plain bagels, bagel sandwiches made with fresh ingredients, and a selection of beverages such as lattes.

spots.name: Le Reve Cafe / Fire Pit
spots.desc: Le Reve Cafe is offering brunch dishes, desserts, and coffee. The menu includes items such as rice-based brunch plates, French toast, croffles, cheese plates, and a selection of desserts, providing both light meals and café-style options.

spots.name: Lazy Oven
spots.desc: Lazy Oven is a café offering bagels, desserts, and a selection of specialty drinks. The menu includes a Dubai style chewy cookie.

spots.name: Suisio
spots.desc: Suisio is offering handmade breads, cookies, cakes, croffles, and ice cream, along with seasonal or limited-time drinks and house-made syrups.

spots.name: Balance Kitchen
spots.desc: Balance Kitchen is a restaurant and bar offering a range of Western style dishes alongside alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. The menu includes seafood and meat plates, pasta, pizza, and shared platters, as well as cocktails, highballs, wine, whisky, and beer.

spots.name: Icheon Ceramics Village
spots.desc: Over 300 small shops and workshops sharing the goal to pass on Korean Ceramic making traditions onto the next generation. You can experience ceramic making itself or purchase a few unique pieces.

spots.name: Starlight Garden Space
spots.desc: It is a place where various images of the universe are displayed, and you can take pictures in many photo zones.

spots.name: The Pig Museum
spots.desc: This is an educational farm where you can learn about life and environmental love.

spots.name: Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum
spots.desc: Icheon Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum is a dinosaur-themed arboretum that combines dinosaur and insect themes with the arboretum in a fir forest of 80,000 pyeong at the foot of the arterial mountain in Icheon, Gyeonggi-do.

spots.name: Cornelian Cherry Village
spots.desc: Cornelian Cherry Village, where the Cornelian Cherry Flower Festival is held every spring according to the flowering season, offers Cornelian cherry theme experience (chocolate, soap making) using Cornelian Cherry, traditional play experience, pressed flower experience linked to the village, and flower tea blend experience. At the entrance is Hanok Cornelian Cherry Sarangchae, which is open in…

spots.name: Shinheungsa temple
spots.desc: Sinheungsa Temple, a traditional Gyeonggi Province temple with a long history, is located midway up Seolseongsan Mountain in Icheon. Within its grounds are various halls, including Geungnakbojeon Hall, and it also encompasses Seolseongsanseong Fortress, built during the Silla Dynasty. At the foot of the mountain stands the Seoneup-ri Standing Stone Buddha, adding to the temple's rich cultural…

spots.name: Eonong Catholic Shrine
spots.desc: Eonong Catholic Shrine honors Father Zhou Wen-mo and 17 early martyrs, holding the highest number of Blessed martyrs in Korea. It serves as a "Youth Shrine," dedicating itself to educating young people on the spirit of martyrdom.

spots.name: Hatsare Janghowon Peach Festival
spots.desc: The peach harvest period in the Janghowon area is generally from July to early October, and various varieties of peaches are shipped from early to mid- to late-term varieties, but the best peach among them is "Janghowon Hwangdo," which is gaining the most popularity from consumers for its sugar content and aroma, and will be introduced to consumers around mid-September. The festival also offers a…

spots.name: Donkey Starz
spots.desc: Donkey Starz is a large farm offering animal interactions, such as donkey riding and feeding, in a natural setting. It features a cafe and rest areas, providing a relaxing healing space for families.

spots.name: Wow Ranch
spots.desc: Wow Ranch is an experiential dairy farm offering activities like cow milking, calf feeding, and cheese making in a nature-friendly setting.

spots.name: Noseongsan Umusil Village
spots.desc: Noseongsan Umusil Village is a rural experience village located at the foot of Noseongsan Mountain, offering eco-friendly activities such as seasonal harvesting, traditional rice cake making, and mudfish catching.

spots.name: Termeden
spots.desc: Icheon Termeden is a large thermal complex located in a forest, offering various indoor and outdoor hot spring pools year-round.

spots.name: Icheon Agricultural Theme Park
spots.desc: Icheon Agricultural Theme Park is a cultural space celebrating local rice heritage, offering nostalgia for adults and hands-on farming education for children.

spots.name: Peach (Janghowon yellow peach)
spots.desc: It is a mutant variety grafted onto a yellow-fleshed peach tree introduced from Japan and was discovered in the farm of Choi Sang-yong, a farmer in Janghowon. It was selected and named by the Fruit Research Institute in 1993, and in addition to Janghowon Hwangdo, Janghowon cultivates various peach varieties introduced from Japan and other countries. Peaches are shipped under the joint brand name…

spots.name: Lotte Premium Outlet Icheon Branch
spots.desc: The Lotte Premium Outlet Icheon is a large open-air shopping complex featuring more than 350 global and Korean brands, offering discounts year-round. It’s one of the most popular shopping destinations in the southern Gyeonggi region. The outlet includes fashion stores, cafés, restaurants, and playgrounds — ideal for families and couples.

spots.name: Ei Jin shop
spots.desc: Binary Sanghoe Coffee, Binary Sanghoe Bakery, The Binary, and Complex Cultural Space. 16,500 m² of walking trail, coffee from a high-end roasting process, You can find a bakery with fresh ingredients, Filming and venue rental and various cultural events are regularly operated.

spots.name: Cavaliere
spots.desc: This is an Italian Mediterranean restaurant located in Janghowon Traditional Market that offers a variety of pasta dishes and course meals.

spots.name: Janggamro Gyeongyangsik
spots.desc: This is a Western-style restaurant specializing in tonkatsu and soba, with an old-fashioned interior and cozy atmosphere.

spots.name: Kang Min-joo’s Deulbab
spots.desc: Traditional Korean restaurant famous for Icheon rice, grilled dried yellow corvina, and soy-marinated crab. Cozy rural atmosphere and set menus.

spots.name: Icheon Dolsotbap
spots.desc: Serves classic stone-pot rice (dolsotbap) with soybean stew and assorted sides. Simple, hearty, and affordable local meal.

spots.name: Hoemori
spots.desc: Sashimi restaurant offering fresh raw fish and spicy stew (maeuntang). Clean interior and generous portions.

spots.name: Naranim Icheon Ssalbap
spots.desc: A rice restaurant, providing a spacious venue and diverse Korean traditional set menus (Hanjeongsik).

spots.name: Cafe Anuban
spots.desc: Icheon Cafe Anuban is within a minute of Icheon Lotte Premium Outlet car. It is equipped with a parking lot that can accommodate 100 vehicles. It is free of charge to all visitors without any time limit.

spots.name: Jukyo
spots.desc: This is a coffee shop that stands out for its spacious parking and aesthetic interior, providing a comfortable atmosphere for visitors with a minimalist design that harmonizes with the natural scenery.

spots.name: Acme roastery cafe
spots.desc: This is a coffee shop where you can taste coffee made from beans roasted in-house.

spots.name: Cafe Jinri
spots.desc: Cafe Jinri is a calm, countryside-view café surrounded by rice fields and open sky. Its large windows face the fields, making it perfect for quiet reading or reflection. Popular desserts include injeolmi crêpes and seasonal fruit cakes. The atmosphere is minimalist and serene, often described as “a perfect stop for slow coffee and peace."

spots.name: The Barn Organic
spots.desc: Farm-style brunch café beside a blueberry field. Serves organic brunches and desserts in a bright, rustic setting.

spots.name: Take Green Coffee
spots.desc: Eco-themed café with garden tents and outdoor seating. Known for vanilla cream latte and black sesame cream latte.

spots.name: Mosan Farm
spots.desc: A farm offering scheduled experiences such as feeding and milking cows, making ice cream, and riding a tractor. Longer programs may also include cheese and pizza making. Programs and schedules vary by season.
spots.hours: 11:00 AM – 17:00 PM (Experience programs operate starting at 11:00; schedules vary by season: spring/fall / summer /…
spots.price: Basic experience (about 1.5-2 hours): includes calf feeding, milking, feeding hay, making ice cream, farm tour. ₩15,000…

spots.name: Woonong Ostrich Farm
spots.desc: An ostrich farm where visitors can learn about ostriches and other birds and take part in feeding experiences. Online reservations are available.

spots.name: Camp Greaves Visitor Center
spots.desc: Former US army base near the DMZ, used since the armistice until 2007. It now functions as an art gallery and is interesting to explore the other abandoned facilities.

spots.name: Pyeong Hwa Land
spots.desc: A small amusement park near Imjingak and Pyeonghwa Nuri Park, with rides including a carousel, bumper cars and a Viking ship. Many rides are aimed at children; check height and weight restrictions before buying tickets.
spots.hours: Hours vary by season, day and weather; check the official website before visiting.
spots.price: Rides are ticketed; check the official website for current prices.

spots.name: Paju Hwangpo Sailboat
spots.desc: Sailboats were the mode of transportation during the Chosun Dynasty. Today, tourists will have the opportunity to get on the Hwangpo sailboat to enjoy the scenery from the Imjin River Dojiri to Jajangri.

spots.name: Gamaksan Mountain
spots.desc: Famous mountain with various hiking opportunities. The suspension bridge "Chulleong" is also located there.

spots.name: Paju Premium Outlets
spots.desc: An outlet shopping complex with domestic and international fashion brands, restaurants, cafés, a fountain, and a clock tower. The complex also has indoor and outdoor shopping areas.

spots.name: Lotte Premium Outlets Paju Branch
spots.desc: Lotte Premium Outlet has about 250 premium brands. In addition, this outlet has cinema (7 theaters).

spots.name: Hao Binh
spots.desc: Vietnamese restaurant specializing in Pho noodle soup with beef, but offering other dishes such as fried rice and noodle soups as well. The restaurant also offers vegetarian options.

spots.name: Joy’s
spots.desc: It is recognized a national chain of family Korean restaurants whose specialties include meals with ribs, chicken and steaks.

spots.name: Sudosa Temple
spots.desc: Known for its serene environment and traditional temple food.

spots.name: Asan Lake
spots.desc: An artificial freshwater lake at the mouth of Anseongcheon Stream.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Natural Theme Botanical Garden
spots.desc: There are 5,200 plants of 161 species growing in a glass greenhouse with an area of 880 ㎡. It consists of a self-sustaining botanical garden decorated with trees, herbaceous plants, herbs, and sheep plants, and a tropical garden planted with subtropical plants and succulents, as well as rare plants. In addition to the pond and small waterfall, stone lanterns, water expansion, jangdokdae, and…

spots.name: Songtan Special Tourist Zone
spots.desc: The Xinjiang district is a street centered on the Xinjiang district shopping mall, which was completed in 1998. People can properly enjoy shopping and relaxation while walking on about 300 m of pedestrian paths starting from the front of the U.S. military base.
spots.addr: Seojeong-dong, Sinjang 1 and 2 dong, Jisan-dong, and Songbuk-dong

spots.name: Picnic Garden
spots.desc: Picnic Garden is a wetland park built in Gungri, Godeok-myeon, Pyeongtaek-si.

spots.name: Sopoong Zoo
spots.desc: A family-friendly zoo located in Pyeongtaek, offering various animal experiences along with barbecue and water play areas.

spots.name: Jinwi Stream Citizen Park
spots.desc: A peaceful park along the Jinwi Stream, where many people enjoy walking and cycling. Easily accessible from the city center.

spots.name: Baedari Reservoir Ecological Park
spots.desc: A beautiful natural park around the Baedari Reservoir, perfect for hiking and enjoying the tranquility of nature.

spots.name: Buraksan Forest Experience Center
spots.desc: A nature experience center located at the foot of Buraksan Mountain, where visitors can explore hiking trails, enjoy the surrounding nature, and participate in educational programs on environmental conservation.

spots.name: The West Sea Protection Hall
spots.desc: A memorial hall dedicated to the soldiers who sacrificed their lives during the Battle of Yeonpyeong and other conflicts in the West Sea. The museum features exhibits on the naval battles and the history of the region.
spots.price: Adults: 3,000 KRW, Students: 2,000 KRW, Free for children under 7

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Statue of Peace
spots.desc: A statue dedicated to the comfort women of World War II, symbolizing the struggle for peace and justice. The statue stands as a reminder of the need for remembrance and reconciliation.

spots.name: Pyeongtaekho Drive-in Theater
spots.desc: A retro-style drive-in theater located near Pyeongtaek Lake, offering a unique movie-watching experience where visitors can enjoy films from the comfort of their cars.

spots.name: Mangisa Temple
spots.desc: A serene Buddhist temple known for its beautiful surroundings and historical significance. Visitors can experience traditional temple life and meditation practices. The temple also features a stunning pagoda and peaceful walking paths through nature.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Agricultural Eco-Park
spots.desc: Pyeongtaek Agricultural Eco-Park offers a unique opportunity to explore Korea's agricultural heritage. Visitors can participate in various hands-on activities, such as planting, harvesting, and learning about sustainable farming practices. The park also features walking trails, gardens, and educational programs for all ages.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Hyanggyo Confucian Academy
spots.desc: Pyeongtaek Hyanggyo is a Confucian academy established during the Joseon Dynasty, offering insight into traditional Korean education and Confucian culture. It served as a place for local scholars to study Confucianism and prepare for the national civil service exams. The well-preserved buildings and serene surroundings make it a peaceful place for reflection and learning. Traditional tea…

spots.name: Utdari Muhwachon
spots.desc: Utdari Muhwachon is a unique cultural space that showcases traditional Korean lifestyle and architecture. Visitors can explore the village, participate in various cultural programs, and enjoy the scenic views of the surrounding countryside. It serves as a great spot for families and tourists looking to experience Korean culture.

spots.name: Pyeongtaekho Lake Tourist Complex
spots.desc: Located by Pyeongtaek Lake, this tourist complex offers a variety of paid activities, including boating, fishing, and picnicking, with prices starting from 23,000 KRW. Visitors can enjoy free access to the complex and take peaceful walks along the lake, or partake in family-friendly outdoor adventures.

spots.name: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Korean Music
spots.desc: It was established for the first time in Korea to inherit the legacy of master Ji Young-hee, the father of modernization of Korean traditional music, and to preserve and inform the tradition of modern and contemporary music in Korea. It has more than 70,000 pieces of contemporary music materials, ancient documents, and old records donated by top music scholars in Korea, and is a complex cultural…

spots.name: Ahn Jung-ri Artist Square
spots.desc: It consists of a total of 10 buildings, including a pure arts center, a living arts center, a performing arts center, and a creative workshop, and is a complex cultural and artistic space where anyone can enjoy various exhibitions, performances, residence operation, art education, and festivals.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Herb Farm
spots.desc: It is an eco-friendly naturalist rural experience education farm based on agriculture and horticulture, with nature-friendly spaces and themed gardens such as plants, roses, and herb gardens. It offers a variety of experience classes, including cooking experiences led by instructors using directly harvested materials, and there is also a space for group activities such as workshops.

spots.name: Chorok Miso Village
spots.desc: It is a place where you can experience healing agriculture while being in harmony with nature. You can enjoy various activities such as enzyme therapy to boost immunity, making natural diffusers and perfumes using aromatherapy, and creating traditional snacks like nut ssamjang. In the newly established pet-friendly space, you can have a special healing time with your pet dog.

spots.name: Lorenz Emotional Healing Countryside Experience
spots.desc: Lorentz Sensory Healing Rural Experience is a space where new agricultural and ecological experiences are available every month. All classes are available only through 100% pre-booking.

spots.name: Haetsaldeul Weekend Farm
spots.desc: Weekend Farm Experience offers rural cultural experiences while also serving as an educational space for nature learning, where you can heal your body and mind. It is recommended to visit with children if possible.

spots.name: Anjeong-ri Rodeo Street
spots.desc: It is Rodeo Street located in front of the U.S. military base in Pyeongtaek. The street is right in front of the Anjeong-ri Gate, which is within walking distance to the U.S. military base. The area is great for sightseeing, with delicious restaurants, military uniform shops, shoe stores, cafes, and a variety of local restaurants.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Port Mulbit Festival
spots.desc: This festival, held annually in late summer or early autumn, showcases beautiful light displays and cultural performances around Pyeongtaek Lake. Visitors can enjoy boat rides, live concerts, and local food.

spots.name: Wonpyeongnaroo Eulalia Festival
spots.desc: Celebrated in autumn, this festival is famous for its scenic eulalia fields. Visitors can participate in cultural events, nature walks, and enjoy photography spots with Korea’s vibrant fall foliage.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek Street Culture Festival
spots.desc: The Pyeongtaek Street Culture Festival, which will be held this year, will be held every month in various forms such as performances, gamaek, and cultural festivals.

spots.name: Pyeongtaek International Central Market
spots.desc: Pyeongtaek Central Market is a vibrant traditional market offering a wide variety of fresh produce, local delicacies, clothing, and household items.

spots.name: Godeok Traditional Market
spots.desc: Godeok Traditional Market is a vibrant, local market where visitors can explore a wide range of products, from fresh produce and seafood to traditional Korean foods. It's a great place to experience local culture, taste street food, and shop for unique items.

spots.name: Songtan Market
spots.desc: A vibrant market in the Songtan area offering a wide selection of goods, including clothing, electronics, and local food. It is popular with both locals and tourists for affordable shopping.

spots.name: Seojeong-ri Traditional Market
spots.desc: A local traditional market where visitors can find fresh produce, homemade products, and traditional Korean goods. It is a great place to experience local life and taste authentic Korean street food.

spots.name: AK Plaza Pyeongtaek
spots.desc: A modern shopping mall with a wide range of stores, including international brands, local boutiques, and a food court. Perfect for shopping, dining, and entertainment.

spots.name: Tongbok Market
spots.desc: An old traditional market in Pyeongtaek, famous for its fresh local produce, seafood, and street food. A great place to experience local culture and shop for affordable items.

spots.name: Sinjang Shopping Mall
spots.desc: A large shopping mall in Pyeongtaek, featuring a variety of stores including fashion, electronics, and food. It offers a great place for shopping and dining with many options for all tastes.

spots.name: Red Onion
spots.desc: Red Onion is a Turkish restaurant that offers authentic Mediterranean cuisine. With its cozy interior reminiscent of a Middle Eastern mosque, it provides a unique dining experience just outside Camp Humphreys. Popular dishes include kebabs, hummus, and wood-fired pizzas.

spots.name: Alice's Kitchen
spots.desc: Alice's Kitchen is known for its comforting homemade meals, offering a variety of Korean and Western dishes. The cozy atmosphere makes it a popular spot for families and friends. Signature dishes include pasta, salads, and traditional Korean comfort food, all prepared with fresh ingredients.

spots.name: Go Bok Su Naengmyeon
spots.desc: Go Bok Su Pyongyang Naengmyeon is a renowned restaurant in Pyeongtaek with over 80 years of history, that is operated by the third generation of the family. It is famous for maintaining the traditional taste of Pyongyang naengmyeon, offering a flavorful broth and chewy noodles that have been perfected over decades.

spots.name: Monte Bianco
spots.desc: A scenic restaurant with a view of the Seohae Bridge, located at Pyeongtaek Port and one of Pyeongtaek’s landmarks. This rotating restaurant completes a 360-degree turn every two hours. Signature dishes include lobster, steak, pasta, and wine, making it a great choice for special occasions. It’s a perfect spot to enjoy a leisurely meal while watching the sunset in a beautiful ambiance.

spots.name: Songtan Choi's Original Budae Jjigae
spots.desc: Songtan Choi's Original Budae Jjigae, established in 1969, is famous for its rich and spicy budae jjigae (army stew). It is recognized as the largest budae jjigae restaurant in Korea, located near the Songtan U.S. military base.

spots.name: Gyeong Jjamppong
spots.desc: Known for its flavorful jjamppong and crispy tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork).

spots.name: Lee Chang Jin Gamasot Gomtang
spots.desc: Renowned for its clean and rich broth, offering a variety of traditional Korean soups like gomtang and galbitang.

spots.name: Cheonghakdong Naengmyeon
spots.desc: Popular for its cold naengmyeon (noodle soup) with a refreshing and mild taste, perfect for summer.

spots.name: Mandeugi Alley
spots.desc: A popular street food alley offering delicious tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes) and sundae (Korean blood sausage).

spots.name: Seoul Myeonok
spots.desc: It is a popular restaurant in Pyeongtaek that maintains its traditional taste. Naengmyeon is the main menu, and in addition to Naengmyeon, there are a variety of menus such as galbitang, steamed beef ribs, and bulgogi hot pot, especially galbitang, which is praised for its deep and light broth and soft meat.

spots.name: Manse Haejanggukbap
spots.desc: A local favorite haejangguk (hangover soup) restaurant, famous for its rich flavor and generous portions. The spicy intestine soup and beef hangover soup are highly recommended. Closed on Mondays.

spots.name: Jeongmun An-gyeong Twigim
spots.desc: A fried snack shop in Songtan Central Market serving squid, onion, shrimp, and other battered fried foods. The snacks are seasoned with a house salt blend rather than the soy-based dipping sauce commonly served with Korean fried snacks.

spots.name: Ssangyong Chicken
spots.desc: A chicken shop serving fried and seasoned chicken. The fried chicken is sprinkled with garlic seasoning and served with house-made pickled radish containing chili peppers. Takeaway and delivery are available.

spots.name: Miss Jin Hamburger
spots.desc: A hamburger shop near Osan Air Base serving Korean-style burgers with ingredients such as shredded cabbage, fried eggs, and beef patties. The menu also includes bulgogi burgers, sandwiches, and hot dogs. Takeaway is available.

spots.name: Zenta Cafe
spots.desc: A cozy cafe famous for its vanilla latte and desserts. Perfect for relaxing in a chic atmosphere.

spots.name: Tough Enough Roasters VER2
spots.desc: Known for great coffee and stylish interiors. Parking might be challenging during busy hours.

spots.name: Café Seodaeul
spots.desc: A quaint countryside cafe run by an elderly couple, offering excellent coffee and nostalgic vibes.

spots.name: Taj
spots.desc: A lovely cafe located on the outskirts of Pyeongtaek, known for its beautiful interior, perfect for a relaxing coffee break.

spots.name: Café Rebirth
spots.desc: A cozy café offering vegan desserts and drinks with a white and wood interior. The café also provides parking space for convenience.

spots.name: west157

spots.name: Uijeongbu Music Library

It is not recommended to bring a car because Green Road doesn't allow…

Andeok Valley was named because seven days after the sky cried, the ground vibrated, and clouds and fog formed, the great gods rose and the stream meandered between the rock walls, making it a place of peace. The sap…

spots.name: Jeju Sculpture Park
spots.desc: This park near Mt. Sanbang is a relaxing walking area where you can discover over 160 sculptures in a peaceful atmosphere. The sculpture park also has an observation tower.

spots.name: Gaetkak Jusangjeolli Cliff
spots.desc: Although the access road is cramped and there is an unpaved rocky road by the sea, it is a place where you can feel the sea and hundreds of years of sea scent while stepping on the bumpy rocks. It boasts the best place as a photo zone, fully feeling the appearance of different stones, sea breeze, and sea scent.

spots.name: Jeju Folk Village Museum
spots.desc: Not to be confused with the above, this is a created museum that presents a vivid and lively exhibition of the island's cultural assets. Built on an area of over 150,000 m², the village has reconstructed and moved living structures from varies styles. Get the audioguide: a steal at only ₩2,000. Pace yourself, seeing everything can take up to 4 hours.

spots.name: Soingook Miniature Theme Park
spots.desc: Here you can get up close to small scaled replicas of some of the most famous structures from more than 30 countries. Leaning Tower of Pisa, Taj Mahal and many Korean sites are part of this interesting display. The two parks are in different parts of Jeju Island.

spots.name: Botanical Garden Yeomiji
spots.desc: The largest botanical garden in Asia, the magnificent glass Yeomiji Conservatory has collected and displayed 1,200 species of subtropical and tropical plants. There are five permanent gardens as well as the temporary horticultural displays and flower show. you can stroll through the traditional outdoor gardens of Korea, Japan, Italy and France admiring the unique classical design of each.

spots.name: Micheon Cave
spots.desc: Fresh air, crystal clear water, green fields, and a secondary volcanic cone (oreum) create an awe-inspiring sight.

spots.name: Sunken Ship 1

spots.name: Jusangjeolli Cliff of Daepo

spots.name: Camellia Hill
spots.desc: A 172,000 square meter camellia arboretum. Home to 6,000 camellia trees of 500 different species.

spots.name: Dumoak
spots.desc: Gallery featuring prints from the photographer Kim Young-gap.

spots.name: Chocolate Museum
spots.desc: This is the second largest museum in the world. The building looks like a fortress of rocks but smells sweet. The hand-made chocolate set from this museum makes a great gift to take away from Jeju.

spots.name: Green Tea Museum
spots.desc: Located among plantations of green tea, this museum is built in the shape of a teacup. Here you can see tea collecting methods and take pictures in the middle of tea plantations. The O'Sulloc tea museum teaches you about Korean tea culture through a miniature of a green tea production line and many other interesting activities. There is a souvenir shop and of course a green tea-house with green…

spots.name: World 'Eros' Museum
spots.desc: At first glance, Seogwipo's answer to the infamous Loveland, this attraction actually lives up to its title: a museum. A museum that has amassed genuine erotic works of art from the world over and put them on display next to a pile of cheaply Photoshopped "flowers" and some Japanese pornography playing in a traditional house-front with holes poked in the paper screens... but a museum…

spots.name: Jeju Teddy Bear Museum
spots.desc: Millions of people around the world collect Teddy Bears and they seek out old, unique, and valuable teddy bears for their personal collections. The Jeju Teddy Bear Museum opened especially for the European collectors and is more exciting than ever with special "Teddy Bear" entertainment. Some scenes from the popular Korean Drama "Goong (궁)" was filmed in this museum.

spots.name: Jeju Shinyoung Cinema Museum
spots.desc: This is the first movie museum in Korea. It was established by Shin Young-gyun, a movie actor and displays pictures of movie stars.(temporary closed).

spots.name: Seobok Exhibition Hall
spots.desc: A tiny museum of Xu Fu, a Chinese alchemist and explorer. He was sent by Qin Shi Huang to the eastern seas twice to look for the elixir of life. Xu Fu reached the Jeongbang waterfall then sailed west, some say that's where the name "Seogwipo"("西歸浦" in Chinese, literal meaning is "return west shore") comes from.

spots.name: Submarine tours
spots.desc: Located in the harbour, you have the opportunity to experience going down to a depth of 40 m below the water surface on a submarine trip. With a course around 2.8 km long, a tour is a great way to see below the surface of Jeju's splendid seas. Here you can see the world of soft corals and colorful fish all amid a fantastic underwater landscape near Munsom Islet. You may even be lucky enough to…
spots.price: An hour trip costs ₩45,000 for adults, and ₩25,000 for children

spots.name: Jeju Water World
spots.desc: Family-friendly water park consisting of a large indoor section quite literally under the south grandstands and a small outdoor section off to the side. Has a sauna and jjimjilbang attached.
spots.price: ₩21,000 for water park admission (₩8,000 for sauna, ₩10,000 for jjimjilbang)

spots.name: Bangeo Festival

spots.name: Jeju Canola Festival
spots.desc: When spring comes, yellow rape flowers bloom all over Jeju Island. The rape flower festival, designed to praise the beauty of rape flowers, combines the three colors of Jeju's blue sea, stone walls next to the road, and yellow rape flowers to deliver love to lovers and dreams to families.
spots.hours: In the middle of April every year

spots.price: Set menus for two people start at around ₩100,000

spots.name: Jeju Black Pork Restaurant
