spots.desc: It is fried immediately with fresh ingredients and clean oil and crispy, and it is served as a meal by adding sweet and salty taste with Onsen's special secret recipe Tare sauce.

spots.name: Fresh Pot Rice
spots.desc: You can put various toppings on the hot pot rice, eat as much as you like, and finish with warm pressed rice.

spots.name: God of Seosan Bulgogi and White Pork
spots.desc: It provides a Korean table composition using Seosan specialties.

spots.name: Jusarang
spots.desc: Jusarang is in Seosan Lake Park. It's a jukkumi restaurant that you can only eat in Seosan. The owner of the webfoot octopus with 15 years of experience.

spots.name: Dodam Shabu hand noodle soup
spots.desc: You can taste the representative Korean beef shabu hot pot with Korean beef fan meat and skirt meat, and hand noodle soup with spicy or clear broth to your liking.

spots.name: Big Village Nutrition Oyster Rice
spots.desc: It specializes in oyster dishes such as oyster rice and green onion pancakes by cleaning fresh oysters in Ganwoldo Island.

spots.name: Flavorite
spots.desc: It is a warm bakery that kneads and bakes every day in the store with fresh and good ingredients. We also have drinks and coffee that go well with bread.

spots.name: Zormardin
spots.desc: It's a dessert restaurant specializing in salt bread that sells coffee. And it's a small space that bakes its own bread every morning while making desserts.
spots.hours: Fri-Tue 10:00-19:00, 18:30 last order; Wed 10:00-15:00, 14:30 last order; closed Thu

spots.name: a local bakery
spots.desc: The bakery started in May 2020. It started as a small baked snack shop and is now operating as a bakery cafe with a view of the sea. It also runs a baking class.

spots.name: NNN Bakery
spots.desc: It is closed on the second, fourth, and month. If you need to park, please use the public parking lot in front of the store.

spots.name: Wa-flick
spots.desc: WaFlick is a Seosan cafe restaurant that offers a variety of croplo menus. The special menu you must eat when you visit Whaplick is Knutfl! Knutfl is a combination of 'cropple + handmade doughnut' and is a signature menu developed by Waflick.

spots.name: Digging Coffee Club
spots.desc: It's a bakery that bakes bread every morning, with delicious coffee at a roastery cafe that roasts its own coffee.

spots.name: Eunwoo's coffee
spots.desc: Eunwoo Coffee provides customers with fresh green beans imported directly from the local area as roasted beans. Bakery is a handmade bread made with a carefully selected selection of fresh and good ingredients every morning.

spots.name: Caffenoville
spots.desc: It is a space where you can enjoy delicious coffee and a comfortable atmosphere.

spots.name: Cafe Mowel
spots.desc: Cafe Mowol is a forest healing cafe with four seasons of red pine forest.

spots.name: Seosan Ranch Cafe
spots.desc: It is a large cafe with a good atmosphere where you can use brunch and coffee bakery while looking at the wide grass.

spots.name: Cafe Dasol
spots.desc: Various wildflowers add vitality to those who visit all year round on an hour-long walk full of phytoncide in the pine forest.

spots.name: Rang cafe
spots.desc: Rang Cafe is a cafe operated by a new studio opened on the first floor of Seosan Lang Studio.

spots.name: Bohyeon Museum
spots.desc: It opened in June 2016 inside the training center of Daegu Health College, it was designated as a second-class museum by the province in 2021. The museum supports the college’s mission to cultivate talented individuals with creativity and integrity. It serves as a leading cultural and arts education institution in the region, offering exhibitions and programs in collaboration with local artists…

spots.name: Miryang Arirang Art Center
spots.desc: It is a multi-purpose venue with a large theater of 765 seats and a small theater of 236 seats. It hosts various performances and exhibitions and offers a membership program open to all with special benefits. The center features exhibition halls, rehearsal rooms, and popup galleries, providing a rich cultural experience for visitors.

spots.name: Miryang Independence Movement Memorial Hall
spots.desc: It opened in June 2008, honors independence activists from Miryang and their contributions to Korea's freedom. It showcases key events like the March 13, 1919 Manse Movement and the efforts of groups such as the Uiyeoldan and the Korean Liberation Army. The hall features exhibits on various independence activities, including the Taegeukgi Manse Movement and the Joseon Volunteer Army, allowing…

spots.name: Oyeonjeong
spots.desc: A traditional pavilion that was built by a Joseon Dynasty scholar, offering experiences of Korean traditional cuisine and hanok stays. The site is renowned for its tranquil atmosphere, beautiful old cherry blossom, ginkgo, and maple trees, and serves elegant meals featuring lotus leaf rice and seasonal side dishes.

spots.name: Twin Tunnel
spots.desc: Twin Tunnel is a theme park of light and characters, created by transforming an abandoned Gyeongbu Line railway tunnel. Inside, nearly 100 million lights illuminate the space, filling it with countless photo zones. The tunnel is divided into 10 different themed sections, each offering unique experiences. The Twin Tunnel was originally a railway tunnel built under the order of King Gojong during…

spots.name: Wiyangji
spots.desc: This is a popular travel destination, considered one of the Eight Scenic Views of Miryang. The majestic cluster of fringe trees that lines the reservoir boasts a picturesque landscape throughout all four seasons. The best time to visit Wiyangji Pond is in the spring when the fringe tree blossoms are in full bloom, looking as if they are covered in white snow. On a clear day, the reflection of the…

spots.name: Malboreu Equestrian Center
spots.desc: It is a popular tourist destination where visitors can experience horseback riding and connect with horses. It attracts many family visitors and offers various riding experiences and programs to enjoy in a natural setting.

spots.name: Miryang Ice Valley Cable Car
spots.desc: This is a round-trip cable car with a track length of 1.8km, which can take you to the upper station at an altitude of 1,020m. You can experience something new with the Yeongnam Alps Ice Valley Cable Car, taking in the magnificent Yeongnam Alps and traveling along the mysterious "Sky Road" that connects to Cheonhwangsan Sky Garden.
spots.hours: Vary by month (Please check the website for details)

spots.name: Miryang Municipal Archery Center
spots.desc: It is a traditional archery range located in Salnae Village, Hwalseong-dong, Miryang. It was established by integrating several archery ranges and operates as a unified facility. Visitors can experience traditional archery, which helps train both mind and body, while enjoying the beautiful natural surroundings. The center is known for having top-quality targets and facilities and is recognized as…

spots.name: Chodong Yeongagil Festival
spots.desc: This autumn festival, held on October 25, invites visitors to enjoy the romantic atmosphere along the cosmos-filled Yeongagil path. The event features walking tours and cultural activities engaging both locals and tourists in celebrating the beautiful fall scenery.

spots.name: Miryang Arirang Festival
spots.desc: Held every May, this is Miryang's representative folk music and cultural festival celebrating the traditional 'Miryang Arirang,' inscribed as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2012. Originating in 1957, the festival aims to preserve and develop this musical heritage. The highlight is the 'Miryanggang Odyssey,' a large-scale multimedia musical performance held against the backdrop of…

spots.name: Miryang Jujube and Eoreumgol Apple Festival
spots.desc: Held annually on November 8 and 9, this festival centers on Miryang's specialties: jujubes and Eoreumgol apples. The event promotes local agricultural products with sales, traditional performances, and hands-on experiences, allowing visitors to taste and purchase fresh produce while enjoying regional culture.

spots.name: Miryang Su(per) Festival
spots.desc: Taking place every year from August 8 to 10 along the Miryang riverside, this summer festival features water play events, live music performances, kayak competitions, and a food festival. It offers families and visitors various water-related activities alongside local music concerts, providing a refreshing cultural retreat during the hot season.

spots.name: Miryang Sunshine Agricultural Products Festival
spots.desc: Running from October 25 to November 30 at the Sunshine Miryang Theme Park, this autumnal agricultural festival showcases local produce through sales, tasting events, farming experiences, performances, and flea markets. It celebrates rural abundance and promotes regional agricultural brands.

spots.name: Miryang Cinema
spots.desc: This cinema is the only movie theater in Miryang. It opened on August 10, 2008, and has since been operating as a local cultural venue. Unlike multiplex chains in big cities, it is a community-based theater with a small auditorium (about 300 seats) that screens both the latest releases and independent art films.

spots.name: Homeplus Miryang
spots.desc: This store offers a variety of products including groceries, household goods, clothing, and electronics. It closes on the second and fourth Sunday of every month.

spots.name: Lotte Fresh Miryang Hanam Branch
spots.desc: It is a small-to-medium-sized comprehensive store. This store sells fresh food and various household goods.

spots.name: Miryang Food Materials Mart
spots.desc: Miryang Food Materials Mart is a large local grocery and wholesale store offering a wide range of fresh produce, packaged foods, and daily necessities. It caters to both individual shoppers and restaurant owners, providing bulk items and Korean ingredients at reasonable prices. The mart is convenient for travelers seeking snacks, drinks, or supplies for cooking, and features friendly service and…

spots.name: No Brand Miryang Sammun
spots.desc: It offers a wide variety of household goods and groceries at budget-friendly prices. It closes on two Sundays every month.

spots.name: Top Mart Miryang Sammun Branch
spots.desc: It is a local supermarket. This store features spacious parking facilities and provides a convenient shopping space offering fresh food and a variety of household goods.

spots.name: Dangoljip
spots.desc: Dangoljip is a long-standing restaurant well known for its pork gukbap (rice soup) and assorted boiled pork dishes. The gukbap is served with pork slices and sometimes innards, often accompanied by local side dishes. The space is modest and can be crowded at lunchtime.

spots.name: Gamasot Chueotang
spots.desc: It is a Gyeongsang-do style chueotang restaurant that has been simmering in a traditional cauldron over firewood for three generations. The dish features boiled pond loach with bones removed, combined with napa cabbage, bean sprouts, and green onions, resulting in a clear, clean, and refreshing broth.

spots.name: Gullimdang
spots.desc: Gullimdang is a casual restaurant specializing in handmade dumplings, offering traditional flavors. The menu features various types of dumplings, including shrimp dumplings, prepared with care to maintain authentic taste. The atmosphere is simple and practical, suitable for visitors seeking straightforward Korean home-style dining.

spots.name: Gyeongmin Hanwoo Butcher Restaurant
spots.desc: Gyeongmin Hanwoo Butcher Restaurant is a Korean beef place that combines a butcher shop and a dining area. Guests choose cuts such as sirloin or chuck flap tail and have them grilled at the table, with simple side dishes and rice. The restaurant focuses on Hanwoo beef sold by weight, so it may be useful for visitors to check prices and portions in advance.

spots.name: Hyangchon Galbi
spots.desc: Hyangchon Galbi is a long-running Korean barbecue restaurant specializing in marinated pork ribs and other grilled meat dishes. The restaurant uses charcoal grills at the table and serves meat with a set of side dishes and rice in a traditional style. The building is an old Korean house that has been adapted for dining, giving the interior a somewhat classic atmosphere without being formal. It…

spots.name: Miryang Dol Jjamppong
spots.desc: Chinese restaurant specializing in jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup) served on a hot stone plate. The noodles and broth arrive sizzling, giving the dish a distinctive flavor and texture. Diners can also order dishes like dol-jjajang (black bean noodles), pork cutlet soup, and fried shrimp. The interior is spacious. After finishing the noodles, patrons can add rice to the remaining broth to…

spots.name: Miryang Halmae Megi-tang
spots.desc: This is a local restaurant recommended by residents. The spicy and hearty catfish stew with sujebi (hand-torn noodles) is incredibly delicious. Since the restaurant closes once ingredients for the day are sold out, it's a good idea to arrive early for dinner. The interior features three large rooms, and there's an annex in addition to the main building.

spots.name: Sansujeong
spots.desc: It is a popular pub known for its cozy atmosphere where visitors can enjoy a variety of drinks and delicious side dishes. It is an ideal place for gatherings with friends or family, offering ample space and friendly service.

spots.name: Seobu Sundubu Restaurant
spots.desc: It is a traditional soft tofu and various soup dishes specialty restaurant that offers warm and generous meals. The menu typically includes soft tofu stew, soybean paste stew, kimchi stew, beef soup, and simple set meals with rice and side dishes. Portions are straightforward and filling rather than decorative, making it a practical option for travelers who want to experience everyday Korean…

spots.name: Yeongnamjeong
spots.desc: Yeongnamjeong is a traditional-style Korean restaurant known for its beautiful hanok architecture and refined local cuisine. The restaurant offers visitors a serene dining experience with seasonal Korean dishes, including grilled fish, hotpot, and side dishes made from fresh local ingredients. Its elegant interior blends traditional wooden beams and modern comfort, making it a popular destination…

spots.name: Assemble Coffee Roasters
spots.desc: This is a popular cafe known for its signature fresh strawberry milk, made with strawberries from Samnangjin, and its 12-hour cold-brewed Earl Grey milk tea. With its spacious parking lot, reasonable prices, and pleasant atmosphere, it's a place many visitors want to return to. It is especially recommended for cyclists.

spots.name: Cafe Nampori
spots.desc: It is a popular large-scale cafe renowned for its panoramic views of the Miryang River and surrounding mountains. It features spacious indoor seating, including a bar and rooms with floor seating, as well as a rooftop terrace. The garden area is pet-friendly and ideal for relaxation, with freshly baked goods made daily and a signature ice cream latte. Convenient parking is available, and the…

spots.name: Cafe the view
spots.desc: It is known for its beautiful panoramic views of Miryang River and the surrounding countryside. The cafe offers spacious indoor and outdoor seating, including a rooftop terrace, making it ideal for relaxing while enjoying the scenery. It features a variety of drinks and baked goods, with a cozy and welcoming atmosphere.

spots.name: Miryang City Culture Center Yeoldu-dal
spots.desc: Yeoldu-dal is a vibrant cultural complex and café located within the former Miryang University campus, now transformed into the Miryang City Culture Center. The space features a unique four-seasons interior design, reflecting the changing beauty of Miryang throughout the year. Visitors can enjoy specialty drinks and desserts made with local ingredients, relax in cozy seating areas, and explore…

spots.name: Miryang9
spots.desc: It is a large brunch cafe featuring a spacious garden and indoor seating with bright, simple decor. Popular for its relaxing atmosphere and scenic views, the cafe offers a wide variety of coffee, tea, smoothies, and brunch dishes. It has ample parking and is suitable for families and groups. The cafe also hosts events and promotions, making it a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike.

spots.name: 1919 Spring
spots.desc: 1919 Spring is a cafe housed in a renovated traditional hanok. The cafe serves coffee, teas, and baked goods such as mugwort waffles in a calm rural setting. Visitors can enjoy the garden and hanok architecture while relaxing indoors or outside. The atmosphere is peaceful, and the cafe is suitable for solo travelers, families, or small groups looking for a unique local experience.

spots.name: Aramaru Aquarium
spots.desc: It is the fourth largest aquarium in Korea. There are also outdoor experience spaces for family visitors, such as zoos, Ferris wheels, and carousels, which provide a richer viewing experience.

spots.name: Sacheon Ocean Cable Car
spots.desc: Cable car ride with a mandatory stop at the mountain peak. All tickets are round-trip.

spots.name: Sacheon Sea Cable Car
spots.desc: It is the first cable car in Korea to operate both the sea and the mountain at the same time, and passengers are highly satisfied because it can solve the regrets of existing cable cars that only operated by sea or mountains at once. The cable car is a course that comes back to the Daebang stop after passing from Daebang Station to Choyang Station and Gaksan Station on a round-trip basis, and a…

spots.name: Sanam Duck House
spots.desc: It is a restaurant that sells duck and goat meat. Especially, duck bulgogi is famous, and perilla seed sujebi is also popular.

spots.name: Sunto Sea Songdol Pan Steamed Chicken
spots.desc: It is a famous restaurant for jjimdak. It also offers restaurant visits, takeout and delivery, so you can enjoy all the meals, group dining, family dining, and friends' gatherings, as well as oyster soup and seaweed fulvescens

spots.name: Samcheonpodol Marinated Crab
spots.desc: It is a Korean restaurant that serves soy sauce marinated crab, marinated crab, and crab soybean paste stew. In particular, the crab set menu consists of a variety of side dishes along with rice in a pot, so you can enjoy it generously, and the grilled fish set menu is also a popular menu. The store is large and there is plenty of parking space, making it suitable for family visitors. There is a…

spots.name: Sacheon Myeonoks
spots.desc: It is a restaurant where you can enjoy a variety of menus such as galbitang, pork cutlet, and cold noodles in one place. It is suitable for family visitors with a large parking lot, neat interior, and convenience facilities such as baby chairs.

spots.name: Original Yangji Seafood Soup
spots.desc: Samcheonpo's representative seafood soup restaurant, the cool soup made of fresh seafood is superb. Seafood soup beef, medium, large, and wild octopus tangi are popular, and they operate on the first and second floors and are suitable for group gatherings.

spots.name: Turtle Ship Replica
spots.desc: Replica of a famous naval vessel that defended Korea from Japanese invasion on numerous occasions.

spots.name: Maemool-do
spots.desc: Maemool-do is a beautiful island group of Tongyeong, consisting of 3 small islands. It is often crowded.

spots.name: Tongyeong Culture Plaza
spots.desc: The plaza offers not only a variety of open-air cultural events but also a refuge in weary moments. Gangguan Fishing Port The seashore of Jungang-dong and Hangnam-dong is called "Gangguan,"where the river flows into the sea.

spots.name: Miraesa Temple
spots.desc: This temple was built in 1954 as a hidden hermitage for two reverend priests, Hyobong and Seokdu, by a priest named Gusan, the senior disciple of the priest Hyobong.

spots.name: Hallyo-Haesang National Park
spots.desc: The marine national park reaches Odongdo Island of Jelloanam-do Yeosu from Hansando of Tongyeong.

spots.name: Tongyeong Grand Bridge
spots.desc: This 591-m-long and 20-m-wide bridge built from steel-arched truss through freight-girder engineering methods spans over the sea from the Dang-dong District and Bodiseom Islet to Misu-dong District. 196 blue-tinted lights cast numerous rugby ball-shaped reflections on the wavering water, creating mesmerizing nocturnal sentiment.

spots.name: Seopirang
spots.desc: Famous for its mural village, is dreaming of a "second Dongpirang." From Seoporu Pavilion, at the top of Seopirang, it boasts a panoramic view of Gangguan, the central port of Tongyeong, and Dongpirang on the opposite side.

spots.name: Skyline Luge Tongyeong
spots.desc: Skyline Luge Tongyeong sits directly below the Tongyeong Cable Car which takes visitors to the top of Mt Mireuksan and offers stunning views across Tongyeong City, the ocean, and surrounding islands.

spots.name: Yacht
spots.desc: You can select a yacht that fits your taste, enjoying marine scenery and sailing at Hallyŏ-Haesang National Park.

spots.name: Dpirang
spots.desc: Digital media devices were installed in each section along the 1.5-km walkway of Nammangsan Park to realize a space of light with 15 themes using advanced realistic media technology.

spots.name: Tongyeong International Music Festival
spots.desc: Festival House of TIMF is a place making "Hallyeosudo" of Tongyeong International Music Festival in commemorating the world-famous composer I-sang Yun. The foundation's executive office is in the Festival House and when Hallyeosudo starts with opening performance, this place transforms into so called a Fringe Performance (all other performances except the main performance) an excited Music…

spots.name: Gwang-do Hydrangea Festival
spots.desc: The hydrangea planted in Gwangdocheon Stream is a species called EndIess Summer, and is a symbolical flower of Gwangdo-myeon. Various hydrangeas-related events and experiential festivals where citizens and tourists can hang out together provide attractions and entertainment.

spots.name: Joongang (Live Fish) Market
spots.desc: The market sells live fish. Fresh fish caught from the clean water right in the front look yummy. The market is one of the tourists attraction sites.

spots.name: Tongyeong Traditional Crafts Hall
spots.desc: The craft hall showcases all kinds of crafts like Tongyeong Mother-of-Pearl Lacquerware made from shells, turban shell and abalone produced in Tongyeong including Tongyeong Gad or Top Hat, Tongyeong Soban or Wooden Tray Table Tongyeong Somok, Tongyeong Daebal, Tongyeong Quilt Bedding, Tongyeong Hand Fan, Tongyeong Traditional Kite and these are sold year around.

spots.name: Tongyeong Special Products Sales Center
spots.desc: All special products produced from Tongyeong are made in souvenirs. Farm products like Yujacheong, Sangyuja or raw citron, yangdarae, sweet potatoes, Hwahwae, mushrooms and Tongyeong orchid and tasteful marine products caught in clean water and varieties of crafts such as Tongyeong inlaid lacquerware, Tongyeong Kite and traditional quilt bedding are being displayed and sold.
spots.addr: at Nonghup Hanaro Mart in Docheon-dong

spots.name: Hongryong Falls
spots.desc: This waterfall cascades down a valley in Wonhyosan Mountain. At the base of the waterfall lies a temple called Hongryongsa.

spots.name: Yangsan City Museum
spots.desc: Yangsan city museum allows visitors to explore the history and culture of Yangsan.
spots.price: Free admission (Special exhibitions organized by the museum may require an additional fee.)

spots.name: Imgyeongdae Pavilion
spots.desc: Imgyeongdae Pavilion is considered one of the Eight Scenic Views of Yangsan. It is well known as a filming location for the Korean movie My Sassy Girl.

spots.name: Yangsan Waterpark
spots.desc: Yangsan Water Park features walking trails, a lake, and artwork throughout the park. It is an especially great place to visit with children in the summer, as the ground fountains spray water.
spots.addr: 25, Sinju 2-gil, Mulgeum-eup, Yangsan-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, Republic of Korea

spots.name: Hwangsan Park
spots.desc: Hwangsan Park is a waterfront park where you can enjoy camping and strolling along the Nakdong River. It also offers a variety of water sports activities.
spots.price: Free(Additional fees apply for certain facilities and programs.)

spots.name: Daewun Mountain Natural Recreation Forest
spots.desc: Located on Mt. Daewun, which features streams and hiking trails, this recreation forest is a great place to enjoy camping and outdoor stays.
spots.price: Free(Accommodations and campsite facilities must be reserved online through the website, and an additional fee applies.)
spots.addr: 270, Tapgol-gil, Yangsan-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, Republic of Korea

spots.name: Ceramic Park
spots.desc: A space where you can try pottery and natural dyeing using materials from nature.

spots.name: Yangsan 3D Science Center
spots.desc: The 3D Science Experience Center is a public science museum directly operated by Yangsan City, offering three types of programs free of charge: a tour, a 3D cinema, and a creative experience classroom,Reservations are required for all programs.

spots.name: Pyeongsan Bookstore
spots.desc: A bookstore established by former president Moon Jae-in in a remote countryside.

spots.name: Park ManSeok Pork Gomtang (Clear pork broth soup with rice)
spots.desc: Here is one of the best restaurant in Yangsan. It got blue-ribbon which is a symbol of delicious restaurant. So, people visit here from Busan, Ulsan etc.
spots.addr: 1F, 1 Mokhwa 4-gil, Mulgeum-eup, Yangsan-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, Republic of Korea

spots.name: HaeYangSan GukBap
spots.desc: Yangsan is famous for pork soup served with udon noodles. This restaurant is particularly well known for its udon pork soup.

spots.name: ImJinGang restaurant
spots.desc: Freshwater fish stew (Maeuntang), along with mountain vegetable bibimbap (Sanchae-bibimbap), is designated as an official local traditional specialty of Yangsan. While there are many freshwater fish stew restaurants near the Nakdong River, this establishment is officially recognized by the Yangsan City government as a certified local favorite.

spots.name: HanSongJung
spots.desc: This restaurant serves Sanchae-bibimbap (mountain vegetable bibimbap), one of Yangsan’s traditional local specialties. Located near Tongdosa Temple, it is an ideal spot to drop by for a meal after visiting the temple. The dish features rice mixed with a colorful variety of seasoned wild vegetables, making it a great option for vegetarians.

spots.name: Aden Wondong
spots.desc: Riverview Cafe. It is known for its view of the Nakdong River and especially beautiful sunsets.

spots.name: Jeonnam Museum of Art (전남도립미술관)
spots.desc: A major modern and contemporary art museum located on the site of the former Gwangyang Station, hosting both regional and international exhibitions.

spots.name: Gubongsan Mountain Observatory (구봉산전망대)
spots.desc: Offers stunning panoramic views of Gwangyang Bay, the container port, POSCO steel mill, and Yi Sun-sin Bridge. Spectacular night view point.

spots.name: Baegunsan Natural Recreation Forest (백운산 자연휴양림)
spots.desc: Located on Mount Baegun (1,222 m), this retreat offers hiking paths, an ecological forest, camping decks, and cedar forest bathing.

spots.name: Ongnyong Solbat Island (옥룡 솔밭섬)
spots.desc: A scenic river island park shaded by dense pine trees, popular for light strolls, picnicking, and summer stream-side relaxation.

spots.name: Gwangyang Wine Cave (광양와인동굴)
spots.desc: A repurposed former train tunnel featuring wine tasting, light art installations, interactive media displays, and a comfortable cool ambient temperature year-round.

spots.name: Haebichiro Moonlight Beach (해비치로 달빛해변)
spots.desc: A waterfront night-view promenade with illuminated bridges, walking paths, and coastal viewing decks overlooking the bay.

spots.name: Seomjingang River (섬진강)
spots.desc: One of Korea's cleanest major rivers, famous for plum blossom scenery along its banks in spring, riverside biking paths, and fresh sweetfish and clam delicacies.

spots.name: Gwangyang Jangdo Museum (광양장도박물관)
spots.desc: A specialized museum dedicated to traditional ornamental daggers (jangdo), preserving the craftsmanship of Intangible Cultural Heritage masters.

spots.name: Okryongsa Temple Site & Camellia Forest (옥룡사지 및 동백나무 숲)
spots.desc: A historic temple site associated with Master Doseon of late Silla, surrounded by a dense natural forest of over 10,000 camellia trees that bloom red in late winter and early spring.

spots.name: Eunsaesa Temple (운사사)
spots.desc: A peaceful mountain temple situated in a quiet valley, known for its scenic natural surroundings and tranquil atmosphere away from urban crowds.

spots.name: Gwangyang Maehwa Festival (광양매화축제)
spots.desc: Held every March in Seomjingang Maehwa Village, this is one of Korea's premier spring flower festivals. The hills along the Seomjingang River are blanketed in white plum blossoms, offering scenic walking trails and local plum-based delicacies.

spots.name: Gwangyang Traditional Charcoal Bulgogi Festival (광양전통숯불구이축제)
spots.desc: An annual autumn food festival celebrating Gwangyang's famous charcoal-grilled marinated beef, featuring cooking demonstrations, musical performances, and food stalls along the river park.

spots.name: Gwangyang Wood Culture Experience Center (광양목재문화체험장)
spots.desc: An interactive forestry center offering woodworking crafts, wooden playrooms for children, and educational exhibits on forest ecology.

spots.name: Drive Across Yi Sun-sin Bridge (이순신대교)
spots.desc: Drive across one of the world's longest suspension bridges connecting Gwangyang and Yeosu, offering impressive ocean views over the industrial harbor.

spots.name: Walk Across Baealdo Island Suspension Bridge (배알도 섬정원)
spots.desc: Cross pedestrian suspension bridges connecting the coastal mainland to a small transformed island garden park featuring seaside walking trails and coastal viewpoints.

spots.name: Cycle along Seomjingang River Bike Path (섬진강 자전거길)
spots.desc: Part of the national cross-country cycling route, offering scenic, flat riverside biking paths through plum orchards and bamboo groves.

spots.name: Hike Mount Baegun (백운산 등산)
spots.desc: Hike up Gwangyang's highest peak (1,222 m) through forested trails, passing mountain streams, ridge pathways, and panoramic vistas of the southern coast.

spots.name: Cool Off at Seongbul Valley (성불계곡)
spots.desc: A mountain valley featuring clear freshwater streams, natural rock pools, and shady forest surroundings, making it a favorite summer retreat spot for locals.

spots.name: Catch the Night View at Seocheon Stream Park (서천체육공원)
spots.desc: A riverside park featuring paved walking paths, seasonal flower gardens (rose and cosmos parks), and an evening musical rainbow fountain show.

spots.name: Relax at Eochik Valley (어치계곡)
spots.desc: A secluded mountain valley known for its deep rock basins, Yongso Waterfall, and dense forest foliage, great for summer stream bathing and scenic hikes.

spots.name: Gwangyang Bulgogi Specialized Street (광양불고기 특화거리)
spots.desc: A riverside dining strip packed with dozens of historic restaurants specializing in traditional charcoal-grilled bulgogi.

spots.name: Samsunghwa Bulgogi (삼대광양불고기집)
spots.desc: One of the longest-running and most celebrated bulgogi establishments in town, passed down through three generations.

spots.name: Siwoogwan (시우관)
spots.desc: A popular bulgogi restaurant along Seocheon Park known for serving high-quality Hanwoo beef charcoal bulgogi and neat side dishes.

spots.name: Cafe Terrace (카페테라스)
spots.desc: A cozy ocean-view cafe located at Mangdeok Port, offering homemade fruit teas, coffee, and scenic views of Baealdo Island and the Seomjingang River.

spots.name: L'fountain Cafe (엘포타인)
spots.desc: A stylish multi-story cafe located along Seocheon Park, featuring handcrafted espresso drinks, seasonal fruitades, and bakery items with view of the river.

spots.name: Gwangyang Maeshil Cafe (광양매화카페)
spots.desc: A specialty cafe situated in Maehwa Village, famous for serving signature local green plum (maeshil) ice cream, cold plum tea, and plum desserts.

spots.name: The city gates
spots.desc: There are two beautiful traditional gates in the city, the South Gate and the North Gate. The South Gate is actually used as a roundabout in the city centre, you can't miss it!

spots.name: Naju Pear Museum
spots.desc: Spend an hour at the Naju Pear Museum. Naju pear museum to promote the history and excellence of Naju pear.

spots.name: Yeongsan River Garden
spots.desc: This is where lotus and cosmos bloom, and Naju Yeongsan River Festival is often held.

spots.name: Naju Small Art Museum
spots.desc: This is a healing space because you can see art works and there is also a cafe.

spots.name: Dongshin University Museum of Culture
spots.desc: As Korea’s first camera museum, it exhibits over 1,500 cameras donated by photographer and Dongshin University visiting professor Lee Kyung-mo. The museum displays various cameras, lenses, and camera parts, featuring models from around the world — including Leica and Contax from Germany, as well as cameras from Japan, the United States, European countries, the former Soviet Union, China, North…
spots.hours: Thu–Fri 10:00–17:00, Mon–Wed 10:00–17:00, closed on Sat and Sun

spots.name: Bitgaram Lake Park Observatory
spots.desc: Located at the top of Bemmaesan Mountain, Bitgaram Observatory is a 20.7-meter-tall landmark of Naju Innovation City, offering a panoramic view of the entire area. The main attractions include a monorail and a stone slide.

spots.name: Poseidon Water Leisure
spots.desc: You can take a motorboat ride around Naju Lake and enjoy various water activities. Amusement rides are also available for visitors.

spots.name: Naju Nabillera Culture Center
spots.desc: Naju Nabillera Culture Center is a cultural and arts education facility located on the site of a former silk factory, reflecting Naju’s historical role in sericulture. The space has been repurposed as a public cultural center offering arts education programs and community activities for all ages.

spots.name: Naju Yeongsangang Festival
spots.desc: The Naju Yeongsangang Festival is a multi-day cultural festival held along the Yeongsan River, featuring stage performances, traditional arts, concerts, and family-friendly activities.The festival includes food markets, hands-on experience booths, night programs, and special events spread across multiple outdoor venues.

spots.name: Bitgaram Light Garden Festa
spots.desc: Bitgaram Light Garden Festa is a seasonal nighttime light exhibition held in Naju, featuring illuminated installations and themed light sculptures.

spots.name: The Hansuje Cherry Blossom Festival
spots.desc: The Hansuje Cherry Blossom Festival is a seasonal spring event held around Hansuje Reservoir, with the main stage located near the Gyeonghyeon Village parking area. The festival features cherry blossom viewing alongside performances and activities across the surrounding lakeside area.

spots.name: Naju Eupseong Festa
spots.desc: The Naju Eupseong Festa is a representative local historical and cultural festival held around the Geumseonggwan area. There are many programs, including traditional games and bonding, as well as historical reenactment experiences.

spots.name: Naju Moksagoeul Market
spots.desc: Naju Moksagoeul Market was newly established in 2012 by combining Geumgye Daily Market, a permanent market, and Seongbuk Market, a traditional periodic market. It sells Naju’s seasonal specialties, agricultural products, and various daily necessities.

spots.name: Yeongsanpo Traditional Market
spots.desc: Yeongsanpo Pungmul Market is a representative traditional five-day market of the southwestern coast, held every five and ten days. Visitors can not only find Naju’s famous specialty, fermented skate (hongeo), but also enjoy observing the unique fashion styles of the local elders.

spots.name: Nampyeong Traditional Market
spots.desc: Nampyeong Traditional Market is a five-day market held in Naju every month on the 1st and 6th. It is mostly closed on other days. The market is famous for its traditional gukbap (rice soup) and loach soup. It also provides convenient parking facilities for visitors.

spots.name: Gangbyeon Eel & Pork BBQ
spots.desc: Gangbyeon Eel and Pork BBQ is a Korean restaurant that offers a variety of dishes, including grilled eel, charcoal-grilled pork ribs, and mushroom bulgogi set meals.

spots.name: Health Black Goat Garden
spots.desc: t is a Korean restaurant specializing in black goat dishes such as boiled black goat and black goat hot pot.

spots.name: Geumil Skate
spots.desc: It is a Korean restaurant specializing in fermented skate dishes, serving not only skate samhap, seasoned skate, and skate soup, but also aged kimchi braised short ribs.

spots.name: Naju Gomtang Samegi
spots.desc: Naju Gomtang Samegi is a traditional Korean restaurant where you can enjoy rich and flavorful Naju beef soup and hearty suyuk gomtang (boiled beef soup). The clean broth, tender meat, and especially the homemade aged kimchi are exceptional. The interior, designed in the style of a traditional hanok with ceramic decorations, adds a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

spots.name: Nampyeong Hanwoo Village
spots.desc: Nampyeong Hanwoo Village is a beloved restaurant known for its fresh Korean beef and carefully prepared dishes. Popular menu items include raw beef bibimbap, premium Korean beef sirloin, and short rib soup. The side dishes, such as soy sauce marinated crab and salted freshwater shrimp, are also local favorites.

spots.name: Daeseung Eel Restaurant
spots.desc: This family-run restaurant has been operating for over 20 years. The eels are first grilled to remove excess oil, then coated with sauce during the second grilling. The restaurant is famous for its marinated grilled eel and salted grilled eel.

spots.name: Sunchon National University Museum

spots.name: Naganeupseong Castle

spots.name: Suncheon Waeseong Castle
spots.desc: Suncheon Japanese Castle was built during the second Japanese invasion of Korea in 1597.

spots.name: Songgwangsa Temple
spots.desc: Dating from 867, this is one of Korea's oldest temples. It takes an hour and 30 minutes from downtown.

spots.name: Seonamsa Temple
spots.desc: A large temple complex dating from 861, with natural tea fields cultivated for many hundreds of years. It takes an hour from downtown. One out of seven Korean mountain monasteries to be inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2018.
